items.description: Engineering is one of the most versatile degrees spanning multiple domains ranging from aerospace to automobiles to healthcare to business & many more. Engineers are at the center of innovation and one of the most sought after professionals in the country. They provide technological solutions to the problems, issues and ideas that affect every area of our lives and are responsible for technological advancements. Depending upon one's interest, one can specialize in multiple fields of engineering such as Electronics, Computer Science, Mechanical, Civil & Aerospace amongst others. With increasing competition in the field, huge numbers of engineering colleges have mushroomed across the country. However, competition for the premier colleges remains extremely high. A four year Bachelor's degree in Engineering can be quite rewarding if completed from the marque colleges of the country. In order to build a career in Engineering and Technology, one should have a combination of PCM (Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics) at the 10+2 level. An engineering degree from the coveted colleges opens doors for some of the top companies in the world like Google, Facebook, Amazon, Microsoft amongst others recruiters. Trending fields: Computer Science Engineering, Electronic & Communication Engineering, Sound Engineering, Marine Engineering

career_opportunities.title: Drilling engineers
career_opportunities.description: Drilling engineers determine the best way to drill an oil or gas well, taking into account a number of factors, including cost. They also ensure that the drilling process is safe, efficient, and minimally disruptive to the environment.

career_opportunities.title: Production engineers
career_opportunities.description: Production engineers take over after a well is drilled. They typically monitor the well's oil and gas production. If a well is not producing as much as it was expected to, production engineers figure out ways to increase the amount being extracted.

career_opportunities.title: Completions engineers
career_opportunities.description: Completion engineers decides the optimal way to finish building a well so that the oil or gas will flow up from underground. They oversee well-completions work, which might involve the use of tubing, hydraulic fracturing, or pressure-control techniques.

career_opportunities.title: Reservoir engineers
career_opportunities.description: Reservoir engineers estimate how much oil or gas can be recovered from underground deposits, known as reservoirs. They study a reservoir's characteristic and determine which methods will get the most oil or gas out of the reservoir. They also monitor operations to ensure that the optimal levels of these resources are being recovered.

career_opportunities.title: Manufacturing Goods
career_opportunities.description: Chemical Engineers help in manufacturing consumer goods like plastics, clothing, paper, toothpaste etc. They develop new products and aim to improve their existing quality. They even find work in pharmaceutical manufacturing divisions.

work_description: Evaluate chemical equipments and processes to identify ways to optimize performance or to ensure compliance with safety and environmental regulations. Conduct research to develop new and improved chemical manufacturing processes. Determine most effective arrangement of operations such as mixing, crushing, heat transfer, distillation, and drying. Perform tests and monitor processes in various stages of production. Develop processes to separate components of liquids or gases or generate electrical currents using controlled chemical processes. Perform laboratory studies of various steps in manufacture of new product and test proposed process in small scale operation such as a pilot plant. Work closely with chemists and control engineers to ensure that the process plant is set-up to provide maximum output levels to ensure efficient running of the production facility.

career_opportunities.title: Agricultural Engineers
career_opportunities.description: An agricultural engineer makes farming sustainable, safe, and environmentally friendly. They analyze agricultural operations and weigh the use of new technologies and methods to increase yields, improve land use, and conserve resources like seed, water, fertilizers, pesticides and fuel.

career_opportunities.title: Biologists
career_opportunities.description: Biologists study biotic forms like plants and animals and the world they live in. It is a good field for people interested in the natural world and who enjoy practical science.

career_opportunities.title: Chemical Engineers
career_opportunities.description: Chemical Engineers work principally in the chemical industry to convert basic raw materials into a variety of products.

career_opportunities.title: Analytical Chemists
career_opportunities.description: Analytical chemists use a diverse range of methods to investigate the chemical nature of substances. The aim of such work is to identify and understand substances and how they behave in different conditions.

career_opportunities.title: Recycling Plants
career_opportunities.description: Environmental Engineers develop technologies to recycle waste material and ensure their proper utilization.

career_opportunities.title: Ecologists
career_opportunities.description: Ecologists are concerned with ecosystems as a whole, the abundance and distribution of organisms (people, plants, animals), and the relationships between organisms and their environment.

career_opportunities.title: Legal Consultants
career_opportunities.description: Environmental Engineers often work as advisors to legal firms dealing with issues and companies involved in environmental degradation.

career_opportunities.title: Conservationist
career_opportunities.description: Environmental Engineers work towards innovating processes related to conservation of air, soil and water. They work with Government, NGOs as well as multinationals engaged in this act.

work_description: Develop and implement sustainability strategies, policies, and ESG initiatives. Assess environmental and social impacts and recommend sustainable solutions. Monitor sustainability performance, analyze data, and prepare ESG and sustainability reports. Support resource efficiency, waste reduction, carbon management, and renewable energy initiatives. Engage with stakeholders to promote sustainable business practices and responsible decision-making. Ensure compliance with sustainability regulations, standards, and reporting frameworks

career_opportunities.title: Software Developers
career_opportunities.description: Software developers are concerned with facets of the software development process such as design and coding, computer programming and project management.

career_opportunities.title: System Designer
career_opportunities.description: System Designers are involved in system designing, logical & physical designing, including structure & characteristics such as output, input, files, database & procedures, etc.

career_opportunities.title: System Analyst
career_opportunities.description: System Analysts research about the existing problems in systems and plan solutions for the problem. They also recommend solutions to software and system related problems and coordinate development between business development teams.

work_description: Design, build, test, and implement hardware and software applications for computer networks. Review company's security requirements, its use of online applications, and recommend the security measures. Retrieve data for analysis of system capabilities.

career_opportunities.title: Hospitals

career_opportunities.title: Consultant
career_opportunities.description: Consultants conduct sub-surface surveys to identify the characteristics of potential mining development sites. They specify the ground support systems, processes and equipment for safe, economical, and environmentally sound extraction or underground construction activities. They also inspect areas for unsafe geological conditions, equipment, and working conditions.

career_opportunities.title: Production Manager
career_opportunities.description: Mine managers are responsible for planning, organizing and supervising the activities of a mine. They are responsible for planning future mine production, overseeing the development and tunneling of the mine and inspecting the mine for danger. Mine managers also carry out generic management duties, such as hiring staff and liaising and negotiating with suppliers, contractors and other stakeholders.

career_opportunities.title: Operations Manager
career_opportunities.description: Operations managers oversee project engineering activities during the construction phase of the mine. They are responsible for facility planning, process engineering, maintenance and application of automation and advanced technology and engineering work relating to project development.

career_opportunities.title: Health and Safety Manger Analyst
career_opportunities.description: Health & Safety Analysts support the Health & Safety department in the development and implementation of the Health and Safety Management System (HSMS), Emergency Management Program, and Security Plan.

career_opportunities.title: Mine Planning
career_opportunities.description: Mine Planners examine mining methods and equipment to improve performance, prepare drilling and blasting strategies, develop production strategies & assist with estimating mine plan costs and economic evaluations.

career_opportunities.title: Mine Ventilation engineer
career_opportunities.description: A mine ventilation engineer ensures a steady supply of fresh & clean air for miners to work in. This means controlling heat and humidity levels that quickly can become overwhelming inside mines and removing noxious gases that may come from the Earth itself as well as the carbon dioxide generated by miners.

career_opportunities.title: Mining Investment Analyst
career_opportunities.description: Mining Investment Analysts develop and maintain financial models for valuation and other purposes. They review and analyze financial statements of private and public companies & also assist senior members of metals & mining team with tracking and analyzing minerals and metals commodity markets.

career_opportunities.title: Petroleum Engineer
career_opportunities.description: Petroleum engineers are involved in nearly all of the stages of oil and gas field evaluation, development and production. Their aim is to maximize hydrocarbon recovery at minimum cost, while maintaining a strong emphasis on reducing environmental impact.

work_description: Design, implement, and monitor the development of mines, facilities, systems, or equipments. Examine maps, deposits, drilling locations, or mines to determine the location, size, accessibility,value and potential profitability of mineral, oil, and gas deposits. Devise solutions to problems of land reclamation, water and air pollution, such as methods of storing excavated soil and turning exhausted mine sites to natural state. Select or devise material handling methods and equipment to transport ore, waste materials, and mineral products efficiently and economically. Test air quality to detect toxic gases and recommend measures to remove them, such as installation of ventilation shafts. Conduct or direct mining operations to test or prove test findings. Assess the commercial viability of new mining ventures

career_opportunities.title: Big Data Engineer
career_opportunities.description: Big Data Engineer creates an ecosystem for the business systems to interact efficiently. Their primary task is to build and effectively manage voluminous data of an organization. They also have to carry out the function of obtaining outcomes from business data in a robust manner. Programming languages like Python, R and Java are essential in building career in AI as a Big Data Engineer.

career_opportunities.title: Business Intelligence Developer
career_opportunities.description: Business Intelligence Developer has the primary responsibility of analyzing business data along with AI algorithms and models. They recognize different business trends by assessing complicated data sets. They help in swelling the profits of a company by preparing, analyzing and interpreting business intelligence solutions.

career_opportunities.title: Data Scientist
career_opportunities.description: Data scientist assisst in gathering relevant data from multiple sources for the pupose of assesing it to gain constructive inferences. The inferences gained are influential in tackling various issues concerned with the busines. Depending upon different data patterns, past and present information, data scientists make various predictions.

career_opportunities.title: Machine Learning Engineers
career_opportunities.description: Machine learning engineers are involved in building and maintaining automated solutions that facilitates machine learning initiatives. They work with huge chunks of data and possess extraordinary data management traits.

career_opportunities.title: Research Scientist
career_opportunities.description: Research scientists undertake efforts in performing extensive research dealing with aplications of machine learning and artificial intelligence. A research scientist is one who gained expertise in the field of applied mathematics, statistics, deep learning, and machine learning.

career_opportunities.title: AI Data Analyst
career_opportunities.description: AI data analyst performs data mining, data cleaning, and data interpretation. By cleaning data, requisite data is made suitable for data interpretation. Any sort of redundant data is discarded by them so that it does not hamper the data interpretation process.

career_opportunities.title: Product Manager
career_opportunities.description: In the field of AI, the duty of a product manager is to resolve challenging problems by strategically evaluating data. He must possess the skill of identifying relevant problems that obstructs the business proceedings. The next step is to get hold of related data sets to facilitate data interpretation. After data interpretation,the product manager is required to estimate business impacts from the outcomes of data interpretation.

career_opportunities.title: AI Engineer
career_opportunities.description: Artificial intelligence engineers are individuals who use AI and machine learning techniques to develop applications and systems that can help organizations increase efficiency, cut costs, increase profits, and make better business decisions. AI engineers are problem solvers who develop, test and apply different models of Artificial Intelligence. They effectively handle AI infrastructure. They make use of machine learning algorithms and understanding of neural networks to develop useful AI models.

career_opportunities.title: Robotics Scientist
career_opportunities.description: Roboticists are generally involved in the design, programmimg, construction, and testing of robots (automated software). They can work on any stage of development, from creating software to building hardware and troubleshooting the finished product.

career_opportunities.description: As a Nanotechnologist you'll manipulate matter on the nanoscale (one billionth of a metre), and could develop new materials, equipment, drugs or diagnostic tools.

career_opportunities.description: Nano-forensics is a new area of forensic science which is highly advanced and associated with the development of nano-sensors for crime investigations and inspection of terrorist activity by determining the presence of explosive gases, biological agents and residues. Nano-analysis is commonly used in the detection of crimes.

career_opportunities.title: Project assistant
career_opportunities.description: Project assistants are responsible for providing support and creating balance at the time and scope of executing projects under the direct supervision of the project director in an establishment. They are also responsible for supervising projects in progress and ensure that all issues related to the projects are clarified and completed to avoid confusion and interruption during execution of projects.

career_opportunities.description: Project engineers are responsible for developing project objectives by reviewing project proposals and plans, conferring with management. They determine project responsibilities by identifying project phases and elements, assigning personnel to phases and elements, reviewing bids from contractors.

career_opportunities.title: Business development manager
career_opportunities.description: Business development managers are responsible for taking decisions and processing an organization. They are responsible right from planning business goals, setting targets, acquiring clients, appointing agents, recruiting staff and delivering presentations.

career_opportunities.title: Service engineer
career_opportunities.description: Service engineers are responsible for reviewing each machine after a specific period of time, so they can find fault and rectify it so as to avoid any major problems in the future. They have to be well versed with user manual.

career_opportunities.title: Lecturer/Professor
career_opportunities.description: Lecturer/Professor is responsible for interviewing course applicants, lecture planning, preparation and research, contact and teaching time with students, checking an accessing students work, invigilating examinations, attending staff meetings, and general administration.

career_opportunities.title: Construction Manager
career_opportunities.description: Construction Manager are involved in a project from beginning to the end and usually supervise all the administrative aspects of the project including personnel management, budgeting, monitoring the progress and ensuring all workers are performing efficiently.

career_opportunities.title: Field Engineer
career_opportunities.description: A field engineers ensures that safety standards on a construction project are met. They conduct routine inspection and monitoring of the equipment to ensure that the workers have a safe environment to work in.

career_opportunities.title: Surveyor
career_opportunities.description: A surveyor provides precise measurements of the site where the construction project is located. He/she conducted detailed research of the land to record accurate measurements and use reference points to provide clarity and meaning to the measurements.

career_opportunities.title: Sustainability Specialist
career_opportunities.description: Sustainability specialist conducts research on a construction project to provide eco-friendly practices and guidelines to ensure sustainability. They take into account the materials used, the pollutants generated, impact on local communities and ecosystems, its eventual energy use, and compliance with environmental legislation.

career_opportunities.title: Facilities Manager
career_opportunities.description: Facilities manager ensures that commercial or residential building is functional and operations run smoothly after the construction is complete. They could be responsible for overseeing that services such as cleaning, security and parking etc. are provided and health and safety standards are maintained.

career_opportunities.title: Cost Estimator
career_opportunities.description: On large projects, a cost estimators are involved in budget development and financial forecasting. They calculate the projected costs associated with labor, materials, equipment, permitting etc., set timeline for the project and may also negotiate with the subcontractors for better deals.

work_description: • Create the budget for the construction process and negotiate with contractors and subcontractors. • Prepare purchasing requisitions, process change orders and make monthly budgeting reports • Assemble a work crew and teams of qualified engineering professionals. • Visit site regularly to ensure progress and modify plans for constructability, safety and efficiency. • Regularly update the stakeholders about the progress.

items.description: Ethical Hacking is becoming a highly regarded profession in India these days and is synonymous with Internet-Security.  It opens plenty of job opportunities in both public as well as private sector. Professionals engaged in this field primarily utilize in-depth computer knowledge and creativity to seek out the vulnerable areas in the systems so as to help companies anticipate and prevent hackers from hacking into their networks. Ethical hacker also plays an important role in controlling cyber terrorism. The specialization in this field as per person's interest encompasses the following: C++ Or JAVA, Computer Networks, Cyber-System; Data-Security; UNIX knowledge. Keeping the present-day scenario in view, people with required aptitude and passion compete for various lucrative career-avenues in this field. For a career in ethical hacking, it is fundamental to have a strong foundation in Computer Science/Information Technology. It is recommended that students choose a combination of Science with Computer science. One can also pursue a career in Ethical Hacking after completing their B.Tech/B.Sc degree as this will give a solid foundation and enable in comprehending the concepts quite swiftly. Reputed companies like WIPRO, RELIANCE, AIRTEL, IBM,  INFOSYS, ELIXIR WEB SOLUTIONS, PRICE WATERHOUSE COOPERS, KPMG are always on the look out for efficient hacking professionals.

items.description: Aviation is still amongst the most rewarding and fascinating careers. Aviation refers to all the activities involving the operation of aircrafts. The courses in India deal with Flying Operation, Aircrew, Aircraft, Air Traffic Management, Aviation safety and economics of the airport. Aircraft pilots are highly trained professionals and require intensive training & skill up gradation. Being a highly specialized job one is required to have knowledge of air navigation, interpreting meteorological reports, lead the aircraft under varied circumstances and be a leader to the crew and passengers. At technical level, a lot of skills are prerequisite for the pilots and they have to qualify many tests to get the license to fly. Getting the DGCA (Directorate General of Civil Aviation) license to fly the airplane is highly competitive in nature. For a career as a Pilot, one should pass the 10+2 level with the subject combination of Physics, Chemistry and Maths.  Post class 12th one can try and crack the entrance exams of the flying schools in India and also clear the physical fitness requirements. Leading recruiters include well known International and domestic airlines such as Emirates, Singapore Air, Etihad, Jet Airways and Air India. Trending fields- Commercial Pilot, Private Jet Pilot, Aircraft Maintenance Engineer etc.

Pros: Air traffic controller is a job for those individuals who have high ability of strategic thinking, quick decision making and are highly vigilant. Jobs can be exciting and interesting for those who are aviation enthusiast. Air traffic controllers can take pride in their job as they are constantly working with the pilots and ensuring safety arrival and departure of thousands of people and aircrafts
Cons: Becoming a successful Air traffic controller requires years of training and experience in order to gain knowledge. Professionals might have to work long hours and it might become stressful sometimes As this is a job which aims at safety and it is a major responsibility, so there is no room for error.

career_opportunities.title: Town Controller
career_opportunities.description: They direct and monitor the traffic on runways, giving clearances to the aircraft about landing and take off. They work from tower centres, as from there they have a clearer view of the runway. They are responsible for getting the aircraft on the runway and from there other departments of the air traffic controller take charge.

career_opportunities.title: Approach Controller
career_opportunities.description: Approach controllers take over when the aircraft is landing, so as to ensure the most effective and fuel efficient form of landing. They are constantly in touch with safety areas so that the landing is safe.

career_opportunities.title: Area Controller
career_opportunities.description: Approach and Departure Controller are responsible for monitoring the aircraft in the controlled airspace in order to ensure saftety. They use technical equipments to monitor the path of the aircraft and provide with important information to the pilot about the weather conditions and critical notices with regard to the path the aircraft is following.

work_description: The job of air traffic controllers involves multi tasking as they have to coordinate among the various departments in air traffic control itself and take into account the safety measures. Air traffic controllers have to stay in contact with the pilot through out and provide them with necessary information so as to avoid any mishappenings while in air or on a runway. They are also responsible for alerting the airport response staff in case of any aircraft emergency, hence this job requires vigilance and quick decision making. Air traffic controllers involves the use of radars and technical equipments to guide the aircraft in the air and they also need to coordinate with the the other departments to ensure smooth arrival and departure of the aircraft.

Pros: Architecture is a very rewarding and satisfying career for those who are driven by the need for creativity in their field of work. Architects work in environments that are continually changing, where they are faced by diverse challenges everyday. Thus, the likelihood of boredom is very low. It is a highly respectable career that will make you feel good about yourself. Architects make a difference to our surroundings, ensuring that our living environment is safe, practical and aesthetically pleasing.
Cons: Architects are required to undergo lengthy and extensive training. Salary compensations received by architects are average, and a bit on the low side compared to other professions that require similar amount of training and specialization. Architects are expected to carry the project through to the deadline, which can often mean working overtime and at odd hours. It is subject to changes in the economy and the real estate market, and is thus volatile.

career_opportunities.title: Architect
career_opportunities.description: Architects work on planning, designing and oversight of construction of buildings. They can work either independently or for some architecture company or real estate developing firm.

career_opportunities.title: Architecture Designer
career_opportunities.description: Architecture Designers are involved in the design of houses and other small buildings. They design various structures such as buildings, light-frame buildings including family homes, agricultural buildings, etc. They also design decorative facades for malls and buildings of various sizes.

career_opportunities.title: Architectural Engineer
career_opportunities.description: Architectural Engineers have the dual qualifications of an architect and a civil engineer. They coalesce the principles of engineering with those of design to plan, design and construct highly efficient buildings.

career_opportunities.title: Interior Designer
career_opportunities.description: Interior Designers create a balance between style and functionality to design comfortable and visually appealing living spaces for clients. They work independently or with firms to offer services in serene interiors, home interior, bedroom interior, bathroom interior, kitchen, furniture designing, luxury interiors etc.

career_opportunities.title: Landscape Architect
career_opportunities.description: Landscape architects are concerned with the careful planning and design of public outdoor spaces such as parks and patios to ensure their beauty and practicality. An additional and increasingly important concern for landscape architects is to make their designs environment-friendly.

career_opportunities.title: Naval Architect
career_opportunities.description: Naval Architects engage themselves in the design and construction of naval or water vessels for the government as well as private companies. items.description: Opportunity to travel around the world, enjoy adventures on the high seas and possibility of high remuneration makes Merchant Navy an attractive career opportunity for many youngsters. Merchant Navy is different from the Indian Navy as it operates in the domain of offering commercial services unlike Indian Navy, which is mainly, involved with India's defense. Merchant Navy forms the backbone of international trade and import-export business via the sea route. Though the career offers high remuneration, which lures the aspirants, but its a tough job, as one has to stay away from home for months. Job opportunities for this career option are excellent with both government and private shipping companies requiring trained professionals for positions in multiple departments of ships such as Deck, Engine and Service. Student's interested in this career must pursue PCM at the 10+2 level and should also meet the set physical requirements. Admission in colleges is through an entrance test followed by screening test/ written examination and interviews. Top recruiting firms - Shipping Corporation of India, Great Eastern Shipping, Chevron & Mobil of USA, d'Amico, Wallem Ship Management of Hong Kong Trending fields - Marine Engineers, Navigating Officers

It allows one to travel all across the world and gain a variety of wonderful experiences. One gets substantial leaves when not on duty (4-6 months every year), so it allows one to compensate for the time spent away from family.
Cons: A career in the Merchant Navy requires one to spend long periods of time at sea, and away from the family. Since this kind of work is strenuous for both the body and the mind, it is not meant for everyone. The conditions at sea are not always favourable so it can be a somewhat dangerous job.

career_opportunities.title: Deck Department
career_opportunities.description: As a deck cadet one is involved in the maintenance of the ship and responsibility of lifesaving appliances like boats and jackets, firefighting appliances and structural integrity of the deck. Other activities include monitoring the cargo, pilotage paperwork, communication, monitoring the entry as well as exit points of the ship for security reasons. The work of navigation also forms an important aspect of a deck cadet's working contract.

career_opportunities.title: Engine Department
career_opportunities.description: As a part of the engine department, one is involved in maintaining the mechanical as well as electrical instruments and machinery of the ship. One would be operating as well as upholding the support system present on the ship above as well as below the deck.Working with engines, navigation and communication equipments, ventilation system, etc. constitute some areas of work as an engineer in the Merchant Navy.

career_opportunities.title: Architecture Department
career_opportunities.description: The professionals in the architecture department hold the responsibility of designing, constructing as well as repairing ships and other marine vessels and offshore structures. They usually work in collaboration with a team of engineers and integrate their activities for the successful accomplishment of ship construction. They are the ones who ensure that a safe, economic as well as seaworthy design is created.

career_opportunities.title: Catering Department
career_opportunities.description: This department is the one responsible for preparing and serving the meals to the passengers as well as the crew. They are also the ones involved in housekeeping. These include chief cook, trainee cooks, and stewards. They are in charge of the food stores and keeping the ship clean and uncontaminated. The strength of this department varies according to the size of the ship and number of passengers.

work_description: Merchant Navy officers are hired on various categories of vessels in the commercial shipping industry. Dealing with the job of marking and giving training and assisting trainee officers Staying abreast of advancements in nautical methods, commercial and governmental matters

career_opportunities.description: Food technologists make sure that the food products available in the market are produced legally, safely and are up to the quality claimed. They work on existing and newly discovered ingredients for the invention of new recipes and concepts.

career_opportunities.description: Their aim is to optimize the performance of manufacturing systems. They are in charge of the identification and development of new processes for product manufacturing. They are also involved in the implementation of process controls to ensure the quality of the products and that they are manufactured in a reproducible manner.

work_description: Food technologist ensure the manufacturing & modification of food products in a safe, lawfull and efficient manner. items.description: Physical Science deals with the study of nature and the properties of the non-living matter and energy. It encompasses wide variety of fields such as astronomy, earth sciences, geology, physics, chemistry and oceanography. The researchers in this field, design and conduct experiments to collect the observable physical evidence of the natural phenomenon. More and more people are trying to get in the field of physical sciences for research purposes. Physical Science graduates can even join IIT through GATE exam. Physical Science is also an optional in civil service main exam. Candidate should have Science (Physics, Chemistry) and Mathematics at 10+2 level to take up any physical science career field at undergraduate level. career_opportunities.title: Astrometeorology
career_opportunities.description: Astrometeorology is the science of forecasting weather by assessing the movement and position of celestial bodies. Astrometeorologists apply their knowledge of the relationship between weather and the sun, moon, stars etc. to make predictions about weather.

career_opportunities.title: Astrochemistry
career_opportunities.description: Astrochemistry combines the principles of astronomy and chemistry, to study the formation, interaction and destruction of chemical elements that are found in space. Their study encompasses elements at a scale much larger than the solar system.

career_opportunities.title: Astrometry
career_opportunities.description: Astrometry is concerned with the tracking of the position and movement of celestial bodies. Astrometrists take precise measurements that allow them to trace the coordinates of various stars, planets and other bodies.

career_opportunities.title: Astrobiology
career_opportunities.description: Astrobiology is the study of other life forms beyond Earth.  Astrobiologists apply their knowledge of biology and planetary systems, to understand the origin and nature of extra-terrestrial life in the universe.

work_description: Calculate orbits, and determine sizes, shapes, brightness, and motions of different celestial bodies Team up with other astronomers to carry out research on projects Develop theories based on personal observations of the space, or on observations and theories of other astronomers Measure radio, infrared, gamma, and x-ray emissions from extraterrestrial sources Present research findings at scientific conferences and in papers written for publishing in scientific journals Plan and conduct scientific experiments and studies to test theories and discover properties of matter and energy Do complex mathematical calculations to analyze physical and astronomical data, such as data that may indicate the existence of planets in distant solar systems Design new scientific equipments, such as telescopes and lasers

Cons: The work can often stretch to long hours, and the timings are flexible. Field work requires one to report on hurricanes, floods, etc which can be dangerous. The seats and opportunities for this career are limited.

career_opportunities.title: Climatology
career_opportunities.description: Climatologists work to predict the weather on the basis of atmospheric conditions. Their discoveries help society  in planning activities, designing  buildings and infrastructure, and anticipating the effects of adverse conditions.

career_opportunities.title: Synoptic Meteorology
career_opportunities.description: A branch of meteorology concerned with the study and forecasting of weather using synoptic weather observations and charts.

career_opportunities.title: Dynamic Meteorology
career_opportunities.description: This particular branch of meteorology deals with the study of atmospheric motion to describe the atmospheric processes through mathematical equations.

career_opportunities.title: Agricultural Meteorology
career_opportunities.description: It involves the study of weather to analyse its effect on crops, to aid the improvement of crop yield and quality, and minimize the adverse effect of weather on crops.

career_opportunities.title: Aviation Meteorology
career_opportunities.description: It is a branch of metereology dealing with the impact of weather and climate on air traffic management. It aims to help air crews understand the consequences of weather conditions for their flight plan and aircraft.

work_description: Collect data from satellite images, radars, remote sensors and weather stations all over the world Measure factors such as air pressure, temperature and humidity levels at various atmospheric levels Analyze and present information to customers in the form of weather briefings Code weather reports for transmission over international networks Apply physical and mathematical relationships and sophisticated computer models to make short and long-range weather forecasts Liaise with colleagues and clients around the country and worldwide. Investigate into subjects such as airflow in the lowest kilometer of the atmosphere, the physics of clouds and precipitation, or global climatic changes Monitor climate variability and changes Examine seasonal forecasting, ocean forecasting and climate changes

Pros: It gives you chance to explore and travel to new places. It is a dynamic career, with many new and different types of experiences. The work is stimulating for those interested in environmental and earth research.
Cons: The work can often stretch to long hours. A major portion of work requires being in the field, even in harsh weather, which can be strenuous. Field work requires one to report on earthquakes, disaster-hit locations etc., which can be dangerous. The seats and opportunities for this career are limited.

career_opportunities.title: Marine Geology
career_opportunities.description: It is a broad domain associated with the study of the ocean floor. It draws from a wide number of fields including geophysics, geochemistry, sedimentology and paleontology to make investigations about the ocean floor and the coastal zone.

career_opportunities.title: Petrologist
career_opportunities.description: It is the scientific study of the composition, texture, and structure of rocks It deals with their occurrence and distribution as a result of geologic processes and physicochemical conditions.

career_opportunities.title: Mineralogist
career_opportunities.description: It involves the physical and chemical analysis and classification of minerals, mineral deposits, and precious stones. This work aids in the classification of land for residential, industrial and agricultural use.

career_opportunities.title: Geohydrologist
career_opportunities.description: This field deals with the assessment and analysis of water sources, identification of water pollution threats, and providing advice for construction of water reservoirs.

career_opportunities.title: Hydrologist
career_opportunities.description: This field is concerned with the study of the properties of water. Hydrologists identify and analyze water sources to meet the needs of present and future generations. Their work is specially important in India,  with the scarcity of water resources.

career_opportunities.title: Paleontologist
career_opportunities.description: The field deals with the study of fossils found in geological formations, in order to trace the evolution of animal and plant life, and makes estimates about their age.

career_opportunities.title: Seismologist
career_opportunities.description: It involves locating earthquakes and earthquake faults using geological data. Seismologists engage in in-depth study of earthquakes and the structure of the earth.

work_description: Collect information in the field, from seismic data and other sources Monitor the acquisition of data to ensure consistent quality Interpret data to determine sub-surface geology and the economic importance of natural resources Develop geological models of the earth's sub-surface to understand the geological structure, rock characteristics and the likely distribution of oil/gas/mineral-bearing strata Assess the potential quality of minerals and hydrocarbon resources Collaborate with drilling engineers at drilling sites on the basis of the interpretation of the data and models developed Produce and present geological maps and reports Perform detailed geological risk analysis of proposed exploration targets Plan and undertake an exploration drilling programme after collecting and interpreting all available data

Pros: Plenty of opportunities to help disaster vicims, and make a difference to their lives. Gives a chance to help the country prepare for and cope with disasters. The work is exciting and there are less chances for monotony.
Cons: Colleges and opportunities are somewhat limited in India. The work can be hectic as it involves field work in disaster-struck areas. The work can be dangerous at times.

career_opportunities.title: Disaster Prevention
career_opportunities.description: Disaster prevention is one of the major and most important task of disaster managers. It is focused on activities and measures undertaken to prevent the occurrence of natural disasters and human hazards.

career_opportunities.title: Disaster Preparedness
career_opportunities.description: A crucial phase of disaster management; disaster preparedness is concerned with the reduction of the impact and damage caused by disasters. It can involve activities such as removing people and property from a high-alert location in order to facilitate effective and timely rescue.

career_opportunities.title: Disaster Relief
career_opportunities.description: Disaster relief is a coordinated response to reduce the impact of disasters and their long-term results. Relief activities include relocation, rescue providing water, food and shelter, providing emergency health care, taking steps to prevent disease and disability, etc.

career_opportunities.title: Disaster Recovery
career_opportunities.description: Disaster recovery involves initiating activities to help the disaster areas recover after an emergency. These activities include reconstructing infrastructure, administering health care and rehabilitation, developing policies and practices to avoid similar situations in the future.

work_description: Analyze and prepare for potential risks, such as outbreaks of infections or diseases, technical failure of electrical networks, major gas leaks and severe weather conditions Complete risk assessments for a diverse range of sites, such as chemical factories, nuclear factories, city centers and major sporting venues Respond to incidents, such as natural disasters, and assess the situation and level of response required Work with various agencies to ensure that normal support for local communities continues in the event of an emergency Support the recovery of local communities to their pre-incident state Impact safety training to staff in local authorities or businesses Raise awareness of public safety issues through attending events, developing information and delivering special projects

Pros: Studying and investigating crime scenes can be an exciting nature of work. The work is stimulating for those interested in forensics, crime and law. The work holds utmost importance for upholding the judicial system of the country.
Cons: The work is inherently of stressful nature. The work can often stretch to long hours, and the timings are flexible. The work requires one to report from crime scene, which may not be suitable for some. The seats and opportunities for this career are limited.

career_opportunities.title: Crime Scene Investigation
career_opportunities.description: Crime scene investigation deals with the collection and examination of evidence. Crime scene investigators work on issues such as collection of evidence, prevention of contamination, interpretation of evidence and possible reconstruction of the event.

career_opportunities.title: Wildlife Forensic Specialist
career_opportunities.description: Wildlife forensic specialists are involved with crimes that involve animals, including the illegal distribution of animals and animal products.

career_opportunities.title: Forensic Toxicologist
career_opportunities.description: Forensic toxicology is a field involving the identification and revelation of illegal drugs and poisons. Toxicologists work to interpret the toxicity levels of drugs and their effects on bodily functions.

career_opportunities.title: Forensic Psychology/ Psychiatry
career_opportunities.description: Forensic psychiatrists and psychologists assess the mental state of an alleged perpetrator, to determine whether a person is mentally fit to stand trial. They may be called on in front of a court to evaluate the psychological profile of the perpetrator.

career_opportunities.title: Forensic Linguist
career_opportunities.description: Forensic linguists work to identify the identity and nature of the speaker by analyzing the contents of written and oral communication. They also determine whether two communications are from the same person or not.

career_opportunities.title: Forensic Pathology/ Medicine
career_opportunities.description: Forensic pathologists determine the time and cause of death in cases of suspected murders or suicide. This involves post mortem examinations of deaths reported to determine the cause and the manner of death. (i.e. sudden and unexpected deaths or deaths due to accident or injury, suicide or homicide)

career_opportunities.title: Forensic Serology Experts
career_opportunities.description: Serology is a field concerned with the study of blood serum. Serologists analyze blood and blood groups, and other bodily fluids to conduct DNA fingerprinting and arrive at a conclusion.

career_opportunities.title: Forensic Odontologist
career_opportunities.description: Odontology is a branch of dentistry dealing with the collection, assessment and evaluation of dental evidence. Odontologists identify bodies and skeletal remains through dental records, interpret bite marks, and reconstruct faces from skulls.

work_description: Analyze samples, such as hair, body fluids, glass, paint and drugs, in the laboratory Apply innovative techniques such as gas and high performance liquid chromatography, scanning electron microscopy, mass spectrometry, infrared spectroscopy and genetic fingerprinting Sift and sort evidence, often held in miniscule quantities Attend to and examine scenes of crime Record, find and collect trace evidences from scene of crimes or accidents Present results of work in written form or by giving oral evidence Defend findings under cross-examination in Courts of law Liaise with team members as well as coordinate with outside agencies and offer expert advice Liaise with police to establish forensic strategies, write detailed reports for courts

Cons: The career can be hard to get into, requiring a considerable amount of knowledge, experience and skills. The nature of work is very precise, and can stretch to long hours. Professionals are required to work with and keep track of a large amount of data.

career_opportunities.title: Digital Cartographer
career_opportunities.description: They compile large quantities of data found in visual images, and represent the areas under study in the form of maps. One of the major applications of their work is in GPS and Google earth using Remote Sensing and Geographical Information System.

career_opportunities.title: Town/District planning
career_opportunities.description: Cartographers are employed for systematic planning of towns and districts. In this work they incorporate their knowledge of soil, climate, natural resources and the environment.

career_opportunities.title: Weather forecasting
career_opportunities.description: Cartographers also work to trace the variations in the weather. This data is employed to predict future disasters and developing strategies to manage them.

career_opportunities.title: Construction companies
career_opportunities.description: Cartographers also work with construction companies as essential members to help identify lands suitable for construction, taking account of the area, it's climate, and the environment.

work_description: Involved with the scientific, technological and artistic aspects of developing and producing maps Present complex information like diagrams, charts and spreadsheets, as well as information in the form of conventional maps Work within a variety of areas, including publishing, government, the military, surveying and conservation Reproduce and update old maps Operate a photogrammetric plotting instrument or a digital photogrammetric workstation (DPW), which views the photographs stereoscopically, or in a 3D format Product diagrams, charts and spreadsheets apart from creating OS maps, satellite images, political maps and physical maps Design, maintain and manipulate geographical information (GI) databases Work with geographical information systems (GIS) to see and design, models and analyze landscape features

career_opportunities.description: Chemical engineers work in a number of sectors including energy, oil and gas, plastics, water treatment, toiletries, pharmaceuticals food and drink, etc.

career_opportunities.title: Pharmaceuticals
career_opportunities.description: Pharmaceutical chemists design, develop, analyze, and regulate new and existing pharmaceutical drugs. Pharmaceutical chemists research and develop new and cost-effective drugs for the market, and test them to ensure that the products are suitable for public consumption.

career_opportunities.title: Healthcare
career_opportunities.description: Chemists in the healthcare sector are called as Clinical Biochemists. Their analysis takes place in laboratories and healthcare units, and aids the investigation, diagnosis and treatment of diseases.

career_opportunities.title: Consultant
career_opportunities.description: Biochemical Consultants are often sought by government and private organizations for expert review. Legal departments of Corporations, Law firms, Hospitals, etc. also hire consultants.

career_opportunities.title: Research
career_opportunities.description: Even though research scientist work in different settings; most of their work is based in laboratories. Chemical research teams conduct rigorous research by applying scientific methods and standards.

career_opportunities.title: Teaching
career_opportunities.description: Teachers and educators are employed at the primary and senior secondary school level, as well as the college level. Working as a guest lecturer or speaker is also an option.

Cons: Becoming a flavorist requires years of training and experience in order to gain knowledge. Professionals might have to work for long hours. Lab work at times can expose flavorists to hazardous conditions.

career_opportunities.title: Food Industry
career_opportunities.description: Individuals pursuing flavour chemistry have professional opportunities in flavour houses, industries, wine industry, food and beverage industry, etc wherein they provide consultancy services and finished products to the food manufacturing companies. This job consists of attempts to come up with new flavours or modify the previous one to make it more attractive for the eaters and work in a lab for long hours.

career_opportunities.title: Pharmaceutical Industry
career_opportunities.description: Flavourists are also required in the pharmaceutical industries which are involved in the production and processing of toothpaste, soaps, skin care creams, medicines, etc. The masses don’t like eating medicine due to its bitter taste, so the flavorists try to modify that and also bring about an aroma in other pharmaceutical products to make it attractive to the buyers.

career_opportunities.title: Research
career_opportunities.description: A research program in flavour chemistry allows you to make discoveries about the flavours and the processing of it in the products. Researches can be carried out under various scientists who guide and help you to make discoveries about new flavours or modification of the old ones.

career_opportunities.title: Cosmetics Industry
career_opportunities.description: Nowadays, flavorists are also required in the cosmetic industry which involves inducing flavours in the lipstick, creams, hair care products and various other things that radiate fragrances. This involves understanding buyer demands and inducing fragrances by working in labs and making it associated with the sensory organs of the buyers.

career_opportunities.title: Academics
career_opportunities.description: Flavour Chemists or Flavorists can also engage in academics domain by becoming a teacher in school/college, wherein they impart their knowledge and teach budding flavorists.

work_description: People eat food which gives satisfaction to their palate, it is the job of the flavorists to satisfy their desire by modifying the tastes and flavours of it. Research program in flavor chemistry can be carried out in various domains which involve research on modifying existing natural flavours and bringing about  a fresh aroma to the food, beverage, cosmetics etc. Individuals hired in pharmaceuticals industry are majorly involved in inducing flavour to the medicines to reduce the bitter taste of it. Most of the flavorists work involves lab work and understanding th consumers needs.

Physicists are increasingly using advanced computers and programming languages in the solution of scientific problems, particularly for modelling complex processes. Thus, having strong computer skills would be an advantage for you.
Cons: Becoming a physicists requires years of training and experience in order to gain knowledge. Professionals have to work long hours in laboratories & research centres. Some Physicists work with radioactive materials and facilities that can be potentially dangerous to themselves and the society too.

career_opportunities.title: Astronomy
career_opportunities.description: Astronomers study universe behavior and objects in it. A bachelor’s and a masters degree in physics or astrophysics is required to study astronomy, followed by a doctorate degree. Astronomers have the opportnitity to work in NASA or other federal agencies such as ISRO etc.

career_opportunities.title: Academics
career_opportunities.description: Physics can open doors in the field of teaching in schools\colleges. In order to teach in school, one can do B.Ed degree after B.Sc and/or M.Sc. in Physics and for lecturership in college, one has to write UGC-NET examination after post-graduation studies in physics.

career_opportunities.title: Research
career_opportunities.description: A research program in physics allows to study, conduct researches and experiments in various domains such as nuclear physics, meteorology, geophysics, etc. Individuals can pursue a doctorate degree in their area of interest after post-graduation. For your research (PhD), you need to have a guidance mentor, who can guide you in your research process and assist you in publishing research papers.

career_opportunities.title: Engineering Physics
career_opportunities.description: In order to become an engineer in physics a B.Tech degree in engineering physics is required. Physics engineers might get a job in various industries and governmental agencies such as ISRO, National Physics Laboratory, etc.

career_opportunities.title: Healthcare
career_opportunities.description: Along with the doctors, physicists create, review and maintain medical technologies and equipments in the hospitals. Also, they are hired in the sectors of radiology, radiation oncology and nuclear medicine.

work_description: Physicists in academics, may work as college faculties- teaching classes and performing research in a wide range of areas. Research program in physics can be carried out in various related domains where you have to determine hypothesis, conduct experiments, and draw conclusions. Physicists analyzes and interpretes the research data and results. They are involved in work using radioactive equipments and facilities. Physics Engineers do jobs in nuclear sciences, computing etc. The work role involves solving complex technological issues. Physicists are expected to work in energy sector, especially the renewable energy sector. Physicists have to collaborate with other experts to establish the most effective and efficient method of sourcing renewable energy. They develop mathematical models and simulations to explain the behaviour of matter and energy. Use coding, AI, and high-performance computing for simulations and data analysis. Work in space technology, satellite systems, and astronomy missions. Contribute to medical imaging, radiation therapy, and healthcare technology. Support climate modelling, weather systems, and environmental forecasting

career_opportunities.title: High-Energy Astrophysics
career_opportunities.description: High- energy physics is the study of the processes that occur within black hole and supernovae. These processes can be monitored by measuring the high-energy electromagneticradiation and particles that they emit including x-rays, ultraviolet light and gamma rays.

career_opportunities.description: Celestial Mechanics is a science devoted to the study of the motion of the celestial bodies on the basis of the laws of gravitation

career_opportunities.description: They usually specialize in certain types of celestial bodies or events, such as black holes. Typical duties include developing and testing scientific theories, analyzing data and writing research proposals. They also spend time composing scientific papers and presenting their findings to others in the field.

career_opportunities.title: Cosmologists
career_opportunities.description: Cosmologists study the structures and history of the universe as a whole, developing theories such as the Big Bang, Steady State and String theories.

Develop astrological theories and implement research techniques to test those theories.
Astrophysicists utilize telescopes positioned ashore and in space to watch divine bodies and marvels.
In view of what they see, Astrophysicists compose hypotheses on points going from space and time to the inceptions of the universe.
Analyze and develop programs and tools to further assist astrological research.
Facilitate scientific experiments to learn more about the universe.

items.description: Life Science is a boundless field which encompasses all areas of science that include systematic study of living organisms such as methodical study of the living organisms such as human beings, plants and animals. Two broad sub-sections of life sciences are - Medicine and Biology. Life scientists are mostly involved in the research and development. Specialized fields in the life sciences includes - Biodynamic, Cognitive Neuroscience, Evolutionary Genetics, Tissue Engineering, Molecular Biology and Neuro-informatics to name a few. Environmental science is basically the study of the conservation of energy, biodiversity, climatic change, groundwater and soil contamination and also for the treatment of air, water and noise pollution. It has emerged as a sought after career all over the globe since people have become aware and are ready to take the responsibility of keeping the environment clean. Specialized fields include - Ecology, Environmental Planning, and Pollution Biology etc. Candidate needs to pursue science subjects i.e. physics, chemistry, biology at 10+2 level to proceed for the higher studies in these courses further. Some of the major recruiters include - Hospitals, Pharmaceutical Companies, Government Organizations, Reserach Centres etc. Trending Fields include - Ecologists, Molecular Biology, Environmental Science

Pros: There are a number of avenues available for employment, including pharmaceuticals, health care, environmental management, research and development departments of organizations etc. There is a wide amount of specializations in the field and many routes for pursuing a career in biology. Job can be interesting and intellectually stimulating for those who enjoy analytical and scientific work. Professionals have a chance to provide meaningful contributions to society through discoveries and innovations.
Cons: The nature of the work can be hazardous and may involve potential exposure to harmful substances or organisms. Professionals frequently have to work for long hours and under deadlines. The path to a successful career in this field is long, and most research organizations require a qualification of Ph.D.

career_opportunities.title: Health Care
career_opportunities.description: The work of Biologists can aid the development of public health campaigns and help defeat various life-threatening illnesses such as AIDS, TB, heart disease, cancer, etc.

career_opportunities.title: Business and Industries
career_opportunities.description: Biologists research and test new products by working in collaboration with drug companies and scientific products suppliers to services to. They may also work in the domains of sales and marketing.

career_opportunities.title: Environmental Management and Conservation
career_opportunities.description: Biologists also work to solve environmental management and conservation issues, to help preserve the natural world for future generations. Potential professional opportunities include working with state/federal natural resource agencies, private ecological consulting firms, or wildlife rehabilitation centers, etc.

career_opportunities.title: Consultant
career_opportunities.description:
Biologists may work as policy advocates for scientific organizations and non-profits, at the state or national level, or can even serve as a representative for a political committee or working group. 
They also collaborate with lawmakers to develop new legislation on topics such as environmental protection and biomedical research.

career_opportunities.title: Research
career_opportunities.description: Biologists involved in research engage in the study of the natural world in the laboratory as well as the natural world, by employing different scientific tools and techniques. This helps to increase our understanding of the natural world.

career_opportunities.title: Writing and Communication
career_opportunities.description: Biologists can also find work as journalists and writers, as their scientific background makes them the right candidates to inform the public about emerging biological issues. Such Biologists have excellent writing and communication skills, and work with online magazines, science blogs, journals and print/media networks.

career_opportunities.title: Education
career_opportunities.description: Life science educators can find employment opportunities at various schools and colleges, as well as in museums, zoos, aquariums, etc., where they get the chance to share their knowledge with others.

work_description: Identifying, assorting, reporting and observing organisms and their environment Study life in different forms, research on important processes and how organisms relate to their environment Performing experiments by means of various scientific methods Preparing, presenting and publishing reports of the data collected Performing field works and laboratory research and experiments Developing new drugs or medical treatments Keeping up to date with the latest research and technological developments Observing the effects of human activities on the organisms

career_opportunities.title: Natural Resource Centre
career_opportunities.description: Botanists are actively employed in different natural resource centers, in both the public and private sectors. The position of a Forest Resource Manager is one of the most common and popular ones in this area.

career_opportunities.title: Environmental Consultancy
career_opportunities.description: Botanists can find work with environmental consultancies as biodiversity assessors, restoration experts, environment conversationalists, etc. Such consultancies are present both in the private as well as the public sector.

career_opportunities.title: Research
career_opportunities.description: Research is one the major duties of a botanist. Botanists with various specializations can work in their research area of interest with various government and private organizations, as well as educational institutes.

career_opportunities.title: Education
career_opportunities.description: Educational institutes are one of the leading employers of Botany graduates. Botanists can find jobs in schools, colleges and other educational institutions as a teacher/lecturer.

career_opportunities.title: Hospital/Clinical Laboratories
career_opportunities.description: Microbiologists in this field typically investigate and research on microorganisms to identify the disease-causing microbes that result in various diseases affecting, or with the potential to affect, the human body. Their work can assist in the prevention of the spread of various diseases by containing and treating them.

career_opportunities.title: Food Industries
career_opportunities.description: Microbiologists try to ensure that the supply of food and food products is free of pathogenic organisms that may be harmful to the health of those who consume it. Food microbiologists thus provide a way to guarantee the food is safe to distribute to the public.

career_opportunities.title: Sales and Technical Representative
career_opportunities.description: Microbiologists also work in sales positions or as technical representatives for pharmaceuticals, where they impart information about various pharmaceuticals drugs and other medical products to prospective customers, such as doctors, clinics, etc.

career_opportunities.title: Research Laboratories
career_opportunities.description: A primary field of work for microbiologists is the domain of research. Microbiologists as researcher's study and test various microorganisms in controlled environments. Such scientific discoveries play a great role in the production and distribution of medicines, treatment of illnesses, and management of health care systems.

career_opportunities.title: Teaching
career_opportunities.description: Microbiologists can work as full-time or guest lecturers at universities and colleges. They may also teach in schools to higher secondary class students.

work_description: Typical work activities vary depending on the area of specialisation. For instance, healthcare scientists working in microbiology are more involved in preventing, diagnosing and controlling the spread of infections, whereas those working in manufacturing are involved in quality checks, finding signs of contamination. However, typical activities may include Employing a variety of identification methods such as molecular techniques to test samples Tracking of microbes in a variety of environments Developing and planning methods to prevent the spread of diseases Developing and registering new diagnostic tests, medicines, vaccines, enzymes, vitamins, hormones, antimicrobials and pharmaceutical products Scheduling, implementing and evaluating new products in clinical trials Growing microbial cultures for use in the food and drink industry or in agriculture

Pros: The job profile gives you an opportunity to work closely with people. Epidemiologists are employed in pharmaceutical and medical manufacturing industry and take a good amount of salary. Epidemiologists contribute to public health by investigating causes and prevention of diseases.
Cons: The study of epidemiology involves extensive training in order study diseases and how they affect a given group of people. The study requires you to spend a lot of time in collecting data and analyzing it.

career_opportunities.title: Survey Researchers & Statisticians
career_opportunities.description: Survey researchers design surveys and questionnaires. They collect the data from their target population, analyze it from those surveys using statistics tools and present their findings from the data interpreted. Topics of surveys can range from public opinion and education to medical and scientific domains.

career_opportunities.title: Community Health workers
career_opportunities.description: Community health workers work with the general public in order to teach them the importance of healthy behaviors and implement public health strategies. Their duties often include collection and analysis of health related data as well as implementation of community wellness programs and strategies to prevent illness.

career_opportunities.title: Academics
career_opportunities.description: As an academician, you can teach in various schools or colleges. For school teaching, a Bachelors in Education degree is required. However, to teach college students you have to crack UGC-NET entrance exam. As an academician, you work closely with students who aspire to work for community in future.

career_opportunities.title: Veterinary Epidemiologist
career_opportunities.description: Veterinary Epidemiologists specialize in understanding the diseases occurring in animals. They conduct research so find out important information about the kind of disease, its impact, how it can be transmitted to humans and other animals, what treatments can control the disease and which individuals are most at risk.

career_opportunities.title: Pharmaceutical Epidemiologist
career_opportunities.description: A pharmaceutical epidemiologist has to study the cause, effects, and spread of substance abuse condition in the society.  They conduct research on the effects of pharmaceuticals on human health and physiology, and meanwhile track social trends and habits that can lead to the spread of the condition. They try to plot these trends and predict outcomes.

career_opportunities.title: Molecular Epidemiologist
career_opportunities.description: Molecular Epidemiologist are involved in medical research. They try to understand of how the interactions between genetic traits and environmental exposures result in a specific disease. They understand the molecular outcomes and implications of one’s diet, lifestyle, and environmental exposure.

career_opportunities.title: Disaster Epidemiologist
career_opportunities.description: A Disaster Epidemiologist focuses on acute and communicable diseases, environmental health, occupational health, chronic diseases, injuries, mental health, and behavioral health. They provide us situational awareness and help us understand the scenario, and gather the appropriate resources. They help us in preventing or reducing the number of deaths, illnesses, and injuries caused by disasters. They also help in executing prevention and mitigation strategies for future disasters.

career_opportunities.title: Supervisory Epidemiologist
career_opportunities.description: A Supervisory Epidemiologist is involved in  a supervisory role such as managing personnel, balancing budgets etc. They focus on a variety of areas such as substance abuse, pharmaceutical development, communicable disease, etc.

career_opportunities.title: Infection Control Epidemiologist
career_opportunities.description: An Infection Control Epidemiologist has to research, monitor, and analyze various infectious diseases. They often educate policy makers and the public about diseases and provide them strategies to prevent illness.

work_description: Gathering medical and health related information, indepth research, analyzing data and presenting the findings. Designing & implementing strategies in order to treat public health problems. Management of initiatives taken to promote public health based on current research data and analysis. Development and improvement of public health strategies and methodology.

Pros: The job profile gives you an opportunity to travel depending upon the area of oceanography research. As a Oceanographer, you will always explore natural habitats. You have the ability to contribute to the preservation of the life of oceans and marine life.
Cons: You are not always in control of your time schedule. At times, the research work can be hectic and physically demanding. Oceanography requires you to invest a huge amount of time, energy, effort into studies. If you have water phobia then it might be a great deal of you as most of your time will be under or near water.

career_opportunities.title: Biological Oceanographers
career_opportunities.description: Biological Oceanographers study marine ecosystems, biological process of aquatic plants and animals. They research about plants and animals living in oceans, studies about their natural environment, take trips into ocean, perform experiments, collect data, and keep track of the activities of aquatic animals and plants.

career_opportunities.title: Physical Oceanographers
career_opportunities.description: Physical Oceanographers use satellite technology as it helps them to study the movement of the water, and the forces that cause motion, such as winds, waves and tides. They also study the interaction of ocean with land, atmosphere, weather, climate, water density, temperature, salinity, underwater formations and seafloor. They seek to understand why, where and how water moves, on all space and time scales. Physical Oceanographers requires to use the combination of theory, observations and experiments to study in detail.

career_opportunities.title: Geological Oceanographers
career_opportunities.description: Geological Oceanographers use remote sensing technology to map the ridges and valleys. They study the formations, composition and history of the seafloor. They examine sediment characteristics such as size, shape, color, weight, age, chemical characteristics, origin, distribution and transport in detail. Also, they closely work with biologists and chemical oceanographers to learn more about historical climate records, animals and plants life by examining sediment.

career_opportunities.title: Chemical Oceanographers
career_opportunities.description: Ocean contains many chemical compounds, elements, gases, minerals, organic and particulate matter. Chemical Oceanographers studies formation of seawater, seafloor sediments, relationships between chemical compounds, how chemical inputs to the ocean affect it, how the chemistry of the ocean is affected by the biological, geological, and physical factors. They also study the impact of pollutants when they interact with seawater and marine life.

work_description: Performing experiments, collecting data and keeping the track of the activities of plants and animals living in the ocean. Studying the relationship between the chemical compounds in the sea and how it affects the ocean. Measure currents, waves, tides, temperature, salt and gas concentrations other fluid movement. Use satellite for collecting data such as sea temperature, currents, wave heights and patterning, and wind speeds. Assist with oceanographic instrumentation system design, specification, construction, and documentation
