Pros: From mentoring Rhinos to studying squirrels, Wildlife Conservation specialist provides with an opportunity to the individuals to be involved in varied work and different projects at the same time. You are able to find work in different geographical locations. The work usually includes both office as well as field work.
Cons: Professionals might have to work long hours and stick to the deadlines. This job also involves field visits which might result into staying away from the family for long durations. Most of the work involves writing up reports or speaking to others about findings.

career_opportunities.title: Wildlife Biologist
career_opportunities.description: Wildlife biologists are involved in gathering and analysizing data about the wildlife, their habits, behavior, nutrition, population dynamics of an area, climate etc. to make certain plans and do in depth research for protecting the wildlife and this information reaches out to people and various organizations such as Wildlife Protection Society of India, which in turn increase their knowledge database.

career_opportunities.title: Wildlife educator
career_opportunities.description: Wildlife educators specializes in teaching the school and college students as part of environmental sciences about the wildlife, the geographic conditions where the wildlife can be located, their habitat. Among college students information about the wildlife, climatic conditions, physiology of the animals, research and survey techniques is dissemented. As there is an alarming state due to increase in the extinction of the animals, hence the educators play a very important role in dissementing information to the youth about how to save the wildlife.

career_opportunities.title: Government agencies
career_opportunities.description: Various government departments are open such as Ministry of Environment and forest and there are various projects which have been taken up by the Government such as Project Tiger, Project Elephant and so on. These departments hire individuals who have studied wildlife conservation and are involved in policy making, program development and do the research in order to protect the wildlife for a better future.

career_opportunities.title: Public Educator and outreach specialist
career_opportunities.description: Outreach specialists are the people who send out information to public about how to manage wildlife in the public and private farms, they combine economic principles with the conservation aids and help people understand how they can the restore and maintain wildlife in their own lands.

career_opportunities.title: Non-governmental organization
career_opportunities.description: Various NGOs are working day and night to protect the wildlife, one such organization is World Wildlife Fund, Wildlife Protection Society of India and so on. They hire individuals from almost every field of wildlife conservation such as policy analyst, wildlife technician, outreach specialist etc. who are highly passionate about saving the wildlife and putting in efforts to protect them. They come up with various plans and awareness campaigns for the population to understand the need of the wildlife and how each and every individual can save it.

career_opportunities.title: GIS Specialists
career_opportunities.description: GIS specialists works with Gographic Information System, in which they interpret data and provide the information to the policy makers or for the purpose of policy evaluation concerning wildlife and their habitats. Proficiency in handling GIS will be an edge for you as it is a technical system and having proficiency in this will help you get a job.

career_opportunities.title: Communication and Public Relations Specialist
career_opportunities.description: Specialists of these sort impart the knowledge about the wildlife to the public through writing journals, articles, photography, creating brochures and websites and so on. This is a job cut out for those individuals who are enthusiastic about multimedia and wildlife, wildlife photography, writing journals, making videos of the wildlife, discussion revolving around wildlife.

work_description: Wildlife conservationists pay close attention to the habitat of the animals, making sure that the habitat is secure so that the animals are safe. Wildlife Conservers also attend to imparting information to the public about the ways in which the wildlife can be protected. Being a wildlife conserver also involves analysing and making policies with the main aim of securing wildlife. The job role of Wildlife conserver is not only restricted to books and theories but also involves field visits to the areas where animals are located in order to study and provide them with proper aid in terms of the environment.

career_opportunities.title: Medical or Public Health Entomologists
career_opportunities.description: Medical or Public Health Entomologists are engaged in public health work in different areas of research and in the control of houseflies, mosquitoes, cockroaches, lice, fleas, ticks and many other pests that pose a health hazard or nuisance problem. Veterinary entomology is also included in this category.

career_opportunities.title: Military Entomologists
career_opportunities.description: They work for the various branches of the armed forces. They supervises pest control operations and protect the military personnel against insect-borne diseases and parasites

career_opportunities.title: Forensic Entomologists
career_opportunities.description: Forensic entomologists deal with graphic crime scene evidence as well as competently discuss graphic or disturbing aspects of a criminal investigation. They have the responsibility to use their knowledge of insects to resolve legal investigation.

career_opportunities.title: Agricultural Entomologists
career_opportunities.description: They are responsible to protect valuable crops from insect pests. Their main job is to develop innovative ways to control the harmful insects and pesticides. They educate the public about insect pests, pesticides and pest management.

career_opportunities.title: Forest Entomologists
career_opportunities.description: Forest Entomologists are concerned with the study of all insect species and related arthopods that inhabit and interact in forest ecosystems and the management of insect pests that cause the degrading, defoliation, crown dieback, death of trees or destruction of wood in forests.

career_opportunities.title: Commercial Entomologists
career_opportunities.description: Commercial Entomologists are responsible to control the pest affecting shade trees, lawns, ornamental plants, homes, warehouses, stores, hotels and restaurants. They work for Industry rather than public agencies.

career_opportunities.title: Survey Entomologists
career_opportunities.description: Survey Entomologists are responsible for reviewing all-important crops in a given state or area for possible insect outbreaks and alerts farmers and growers before a major problem arises.

career_opportunities.title: Research Entomologists
career_opportunities.description: Research entomologists are responsible for designing research studies, caring for the insect subjects, supervising laboratory assistants, recording data, analyzing data, preparing reports, and publishing study findings in professional scientific journals for peer review.

work_description: • Collect and analyze biological data and specimens • Develop and conduct experimental studies with insects in controlled or natural surroundings • Estimate, monitor, and manage insect populations • Research, initiate, and maintain breeding programs for insects • Study the characteristics of insects, including interactions with other species and their environment,     reproduction, population dynamics, diseases, and movement patterns • Write research papers, reports, and scholarly articles that explain findings

career_opportunities.title: Molecular Biologist
career_opportunities.description: Molecular biologists examine the structure, functions and processes of molecules. They define the biological processes that cause genes to become defective, identify the classifications and types of molecules within a specific genre and also use gene manipulation to their advantage. items.description: Medicine is one of the most valuable and sought after career for those interested in science. There is immense scope for medicine as a professional career. It is a very challenging profession and requires utmost patience to excel. Career gestation period in medicine is relatively longer than other career options as specialization post the MBBS degree is highly recommended. Intricate and fast lifestyles have given rise to multiple new diseases, which the general doctors armed with a MBBS degree find difficult to deal with. This makes specializations a necessity in this field. Specialization may include General Surgery, General Medicine, Pediatrics, Obstetrics, Gynecology, Neurology, Ophthalmology, Cardiology, Dermatology, anesthesiology etc. Other systems of medicine like Homeopathy, Ayurveda, Unani, Dentistry & Veterinary Science are also fast emerging fields with excellent career opportunities. Medical Science courses are offered at undergraduate, postgraduate and doctorate levels. At the undergraduate level, an MBBS degree is awarded in allopathic system of medical science, whereas in Homeopathic, Unani System and Ayurvedic System of Medical science, BHMS, BUMS and BAMS degree are awarded. A BDS degree is awarded at the undergraduate level in dental science. For veterinary science, BSc degree is awarded. The competition environment in the field of Medicine is extremely vigorous as the number of seats in premier institutes is significantly less in comparison to the aspiring candidates. However with the increasing focus on healthcare, the number of medical colleges in the country is rapidly increasing. Candidate seeking admission in the field of medicine should have had the subject combination of Science with Biology at 10+2 level. Entrance test like: NEET (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test) is the gateway to various medical colleges across the country, both private as well as public. Top recruiting companies include- Fortis, Apollo and Max amongst others. Trending fields include- Cardiologist, Surgeon, Psychiatrist, Neurologist

Pros: Pay: While a veterinary doctor may not have a very high pay at the start but the  possibility of increasing pay is good and is dependent on factors like the location of the practise and the experience in the field. There is lot of room to grow in the field. Flexibility: Vet Doctors  have flexibility to work in a diverse set of environments.  This position is perfect for the doctors  who crave a continuously changing place of work. Saving lives: Some  puppies  come in  the clinic have life-threatening illnesses and sometimes with liver failure and other issues.Saving a life with your efforts and bringing  the four-legged family members back gives a satisfactory feeling.
Cons: Stressful situations: The vet docs are required to work for long hours which might be demanding on the body. They have to deal with the death of pets and distraught owners . This may have  an effect on them. They may be exposed to allergens like pet dander, fur along with radiation. Unpredictable Animals: During the treatment time the animal might feel  threatened or alarmed and would  try to defend . The situation could turn odd and dangerous especially when the animal is sick or in pain. In such a situation the animals might  scratch or bite. Odd Hours: Depending on the emergency cases and odd times, vet doctors may be expected to work on nights or on  weekends.

career_opportunities.title: Child and adolescent psychiatry
career_opportunities.description: A child and adolescent psychiatrist specializes in mental and behavioural health issues in children and adolescents. As a result, you will have to deal with developmental disorders, attention deficit hyperactivity disorder, and learning disabilities.

career_opportunities.title: Forensic psychiatry
career_opportunities.description: Forensic psychiatrists care for patients with mental health issues in prisons and secure hospitals. They also consult with correctional officials and give testimony regarding the mental health of accused parties when they testify at trials.

career_opportunities.title: Substance abuse psychiatry:
career_opportunities.description: These Psychiatrists are specialists in treating patients who abuse alcohol, drugs, or other intoxicants. Treatment and counselling are provided, interventions are managed, families of abusers are consulted, and recovery plans, including medications, may be prescribed. Academics involved in this field have significant opportunities because it has a strong and active research base.

career_opportunities.title: General adult psychiatrist
career_opportunities.description: Patients treated by general adult psychiatrists are mostly of working age, suffering from disorders such as "organic" brain diseases, psychoses, depression, and personality disorders.

career_opportunities.title: Old age psychiatrist
career_opportunities.description: This involves the treatment of mental illness in elderly people. As a specialty, it is characterized by the unique needs and vulnerabilities of older people, the variety of work settings and the variety of medical, psychiatric, and social dilemmas they face.

career_opportunities.title: Intellectual disability psychiatrist
career_opportunities.description: Psychiatry of intellectual disabilities, or learning disability psychiatry, treats people with learning disabilities who are more likely to suffer from mental health issues than the general population

career_opportunities.title: Academic psychiatrist
career_opportunities.description: Academic psychiatrists belong to any psychiatric subspecialty and divide their time between education, research, and clinical practice.

career_opportunities.title: Eating disorders psychiatrist
career_opportunities.description: A psychiatric specialist in eating disorders can work with children and adolescents, as well as adults. Eating disorders are often accompanied by psychological difficulties or disorders such as anxiety, depression, obsessive-compulsive disorder, or personality disorders.

career_opportunities.title: Liaison psychiatrist
career_opportunities.description: Psychological and physical health are intertwined in the work of liaison psychiatrists. In addition to providing mental health assessments and treatment for patients in general hospitals, they also address a variety of problems, from self-harm to coping with illness and comorbid conditions to physical pain.

career_opportunities.title: Neuropsychiatrist
career_opportunities.description: Psychiatrists frequently treat patients with mental disorders that occur because of brain malfunction. Psychological and organic components of illness are integrated in the field of neuropsychiatry.

career_opportunities.title: Perinatal psychiatrist
career_opportunities.description: The perinatal mental health field treats women and children during a very sensitive time, when they are pregnant and right after labor and delivery. During this time, an episode of illness has a profound effect on the patient, their relationships, family, and child. Preventing such a disease or managing it can be a rewarding experience.

career_opportunities.title: Rehabilitation and social psychiatrist
career_opportunities.description: Rehabilitation psychiatry is geared towards meeting the needs of people with long-term and complex mental health problems. Rather than just relieving symptoms, rehabilitation emphasizes improving a person's quality of life.

career_opportunities.title: Medical psychotherapy
career_opportunities.description: Psychiatrists who specialize in psychotherapy are medical psychotherapists. There are a variety of therapies available, such as cognitive behavior therapy, psychodynamic psychotherapy, and systemic therapy.

work_description: In addition to psychotherapy, medications and psychosocial interventions, psychiatrists also use other treatment methods as needed depending on each patient's needs. Psychiatrists can further their training in psychoanalysis or in psychiatric research. Psychiatrists are trained to treat a whole variety of mental health conditions.

items.description: Without allied medicine professionals, the integral health management is out of gear and non-functionary. The upsurge in the number of patients, array of diseases and demand for the extensive treatment has paved the way for the paramedical professionals who are expert technicians or therapists in providing better quality health care. A paramedic is a professional who assists the doctor in the specialized fields and assists in better diagnosis, treatment and therapy. Hence, paramedics are the key players in the health and medical sector. Specialized fields include- Physiotherapy, Radiology, Audiology, Optometry, Speech Therapy, Occupational Therapy, Orthotic and Prosthetic Technology, Renal Dialysis Technology and many more. The competition in this field is relatively low compared to Medicine since many candidates are unaware of the myriad options and bright futuristic prospects, which the field offers. Aspirants must have pursued Science with Biology at the 10+2 level for admission to BSc courses at college level. Job offers for these professionals come from Leading Hospitals, Diagnostic Centre Chains etc. Trending fields include- Audiologists, Occupational Therapists, Pharmacy, Surgical Technologist

This may lead to development of tailor-made treatments based on the patient's genetic make-up

career_opportunities.title: Cytotechnologists

career_opportunities.title: Immunology technologists
career_opportunities.description: They examine elements of the human immune system and its response to foreign bodies.

career_opportunities.title: Microbiology technologists
career_opportunities.description: They examine and identify bacteria and other microorganisms.

career_opportunities.title: Molecular biology technologists
career_opportunities.description: They perform complex protein and nucleic acid tests on cell samples.

Pros: Making a difference: Nursing is a good choice if you want to be in the helping profession. The fact that you helped someone can be a gratifying aspect of the job. Different opportunities: Nurses have many opportunities outside of direct patient care. They work in many different areas, such as discharge planning, case management and education.  Insurance companies, law firms, schools, etc. also hire nurses Good returns: The salary that they receive is quite high, especially compared to the amount of investment during the education years.
Cons: Exposure to germs: You will be exposed to all types of germs and viruses. If you are squeamish, nursing is probably not your best career choice. They deal with blood and other bodily fluids. Odd working hours: In certain cases you will be assigned to work on rotating shifts, covering a 24-hour cycle. You will be required to work at varied schedules, including night, holiday, and weekend shifts. Stressful working environment: There are times that the hospital is short staffed or there is a sudden increase in new patients to treat. In these cases, you will be required to work more.

career_opportunities.title: Cardiovascular Nursing
career_opportunities.description: It is a nursing specialty and the nurse works with patients who suffer from various conditions of the cardiovascular system.

career_opportunities.title: Critical Care Pediatric Nursing
career_opportunities.description: It is a branch nursing concerned with the care of infants and children. It requires knowledge of normal psychomotor, psychosocial, and cognitive growth and development, as well as of the health problems and needs of people in this age group. Preventive care and anticipatory guidance are integral to the practice of pediatric nursing.

career_opportunities.title: Emergency Nursing
career_opportunities.description: It is a nursing specialty that is concerned with the care of patients who are critically ill or injured. Emergency nurses contact patients in the emergency department, before the physicians treat the patients.

career_opportunities.title: Gastroenterology Nursing
career_opportunities.description: They provide essential care to patients undergoing procedures for screening, diagnosis, and/or treatment of gastrointestinal disorder. They may specialize in endoscopy.

career_opportunities.title: Gerontological Nursing
career_opportunities.description: They work in collaboration with older adults and their families. They also work with communities to support healthy aging, promoting maximum functioning, and also improving the quality of life.

career_opportunities.title: Medical-Surgical Nursing
career_opportunities.description: It is one of the most demanding nursing specialties. A surgical nurse specializes in providing care to patients before, during and after the surgery. It is the largest group of practicing professionals.

career_opportunities.title: Neuroscience Nursing
career_opportunities.description: They assist the patients with brain and nervous system disorders. They monitor neurological exams, administer medication, and consult physicians on patient's progress.

career_opportunities.title: Oncology Nursing
career_opportunities.description: An Oncology Nurse provides care for cancer patients and those at risk for getting the disease. They monitor physical conditions, prescribe medication, and administer chemotherapy and other treatments.

career_opportunities.title: Orthopedic Nursing
career_opportunities.description: Orthopedic nursing is a nursing specialty focused on the prevention and treatment of musculoskeletal disorders i.e. the disorders affect the human body's movement.

career_opportunities.title: Psychiatric and Mental Health Nursing
career_opportunities.description: Psychiatric nursing is the specialty of nursing that cares for people of all ages suffering from mental illness or mental distress, such as schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, psychosis, etc. They receive more training in psychological therapies, building a therapeutic alliance, and the administration of psychiatric medication.

career_opportunities.title: Rehabilitation Nursing
career_opportunities.description: They help patients recover from the long-term physical disabilities, or chronic illnesses. They create a recovery plan, and set short and long-term goals. They help the patient achieve as independent a lifestyle as possible.

work_description: Be Associated with the doctor, patient and the patient's family Look after the needs of the patient who is incapable of doing so Keep an eye on the vital signs of the patient such as his blood pressure, heart rate, food intake, medications, etc. Facilitate the physical examinations and other tests required for the patients Assist the doctors during surgeries and emergencies Take immediate action in the absence of the doctor during emergencies Deal with patient with empathy and care Help the patient and his family to maintain proper health and hygiene

items.description: Due to the paucity of time & fast paced lifestyle, people today often resort to unhealthy eating habits which can lead to the development of many diseases. Dietetics is the science and art of providing different kinds of food to people based on the principle of nutrition. Professionals in this area create awareness regarding healthy eating habits. They help people of different age groups, culture and also the ones suffering from different problems and diseases to form a diet plan which helps in improving their condition and quality of life. With growing needs of customers, today, there is a lot of scope in the area of nutrition and dietetics. Various fields of specialization in this area include clinical dieticians, community dieticians, management dieticians and consultant dieticians. Science subjects in the +2 level are recommended for a career in nutrition and fitness. Thereafter, one can pursue a bachelor's degree in any science related subject preferably in biology, clinical nutrition + dietetics, home science or food and nutrition. There are very good colleges all over India that provide education in this field. Dieticians can find a job in a variety of settings such as in gyms, slimming centre's, schools, hospitals, food related laboratories and research centre's in private as well as the government sector. Dieticians are much in demand in the mass media domain as they help promote the quality of life among people across regions. While most professionals work as dieticians to help people gain or lose weight, there are still many who can get into research and policy making related to different food items.

items.description: Career in design is for people who have a creative outlook and are able to form innovative connections between colors, shape, materials and textures. Designers are required in nearly every field whether in designing cars, clothes, buildings, products, logos, theatre sets, merchandise sets, landscapes etc. While most indulge in computer-aided designs, a basic fine art is also intrinsic to designing. Design has wide variety of sub fields including graphic designing, fashion designing, interior designing, web designing, set designing, industrial designing, visual merchandise designing etc. Each of these categories requires a domain specialization. One can select their area of specialization on the basis of their interest, skill and aptitude. Most institutes have an entrance exam for admission and competition for the premier institutes like NID and NIFT is quite high. In order to build a career in design one should have a bachelor's or master's degree in the particular field. Designers can find jobs in Fashion Houses, Media Houses, Automobile Industry, Technology Firms, Web Designing Firms etc. A lot of designers also pursue their career as a Freelancer. career_opportunities.description: Brand Managers are experts who work to create a positive and lasting impression on the minds of customers, pertaining to their brand. They aim to improve consumer satisfaction by improving service and adding value by monitoring changing trends in the market. Highlighting and creating a brand’s image is their expertise.

career_opportunities.description: Image consultants are responsible for advising firms and their employees about their personal appearance. career_opportunities.description: Visual communication experts major in using computer applications and software to design visual graphics for websites and multimedia companies. These designs often represent a company’s marketing goals.

career_opportunities.title: Graphic Designer
career_opportunities.description: Graphic designers are experts at constructing concepts visually, both on paper and by using computer software and applications. This is done to predict the success of a product and formulating strategies to reach out to a maximum number of consumers.

career_opportunities.title: Advertising firms
career_opportunities.description: Fashion communication experts in advertising firms handle all the communication that takes place between the firm and the media or rest of the industry. They build the brand image of the fashion brand via advertising.

career_opportunities.title: Public Relations firms
career_opportunities.description: Fashion communication experts in public relations firms handle all the communication that takes place between the firm and the media or rest of the industry. They build the brand image of the fashion brand by creating content for press releases on behalf of the firm, organizing and successfully carrying out press conferences to update the industry about the achievements of the firm, and so on.

career_opportunities.title: Art Director
career_opportunities.description: Art directors are responsible for defining the most apt manner for representing a given concept visually. For this purpose, they are required to choose which designs, art works and other elements such as photographs are to be used in order to improve overall look of a given space.

career_opportunities.title: Fashion Photographer
career_opportunities.description: Fashion photographers, as the name suggests, work with designers and models. They aim to highlight the latest clothing trends and other goods in new and innovative ways, through their photoshoots.

Additionally, he/she closely study the feedback obtained from customers to the new products launched by their firms. items.description: Journalists in the 21st century play a very important role in providing necessary information to people regarding the day-to-day life and keep the citizens of the country updated with the current affairs and happenings that take place. Mass communication helps in disseminating such wide range of information to the people in a variety of ways such as audio, video, graphics, animation etc. Today, journalism is not only about reading out news to the people, but is central to shaping the thought patterns among people. With the increasing number of news channels, newspapers and the expansion of technology, journalism and mass communication has a wide scope and plenty of opportunities. Mass communication opens the door to fields like public relations, editing, scriptwriting, video jockey, and radio jockey amongst many others. The coursework for journalism and mass communication provides the technical aspects of knowledge required for the field. Other important skills necessary for the field are the ability to write and speak effectively, interest in the current affairs. General knowledge constitutes an important component of journalism and mass communication. Specialization in the field of journalism is available in areas like sports, politics, finance and economics, investigation etc. Master level courses are also available and are also considered to be important for future growth. Some of the top job recruiters in the field include AIR, NDTV Network, India Today Network, Hindustan Group of Publications, Viacom etc. Trending Field: Reporters, Journalists, Editors, Scriptwriters, Anchors, Writers etc.

career_opportunities.description: Event Management firms are growing day by day. A Mass Communication Graduate can work for an Event Management Company as an Event Manager or set up his own firm handling events. It's a high paying Industry and is growing day by day.

Pros: Journalist get to meet wide range of public figures and often spend quality time getting to know those individuals during an interview. If you have a knack of knowing everything, then this field is best suited for you. From doing extensive research to getting goons out of the dark can be few of the jobs to mention. This field makes you challenge yourself every day and make sure that your talent is put to use. Journalism as a profession is a highly respected job, they are viewed as the most credible people.
Cons: There is always a risk to life when covering events of riots or war. Journalist have long and hectic working hours which can affect one's social life.

career_opportunities.title: Broadcast Journalism
career_opportunities.description: Broadcast journalist are those who present information to the mass audience through electronic medium - Radio or Television and not in the print form. Their job is to present accurate, interesting and eye-catching information to gather attention of the public. They work in the field of politics, war, and environment.

career_opportunities.title: Public Relations
career_opportunities.description: Public relations managers work is to gather attention of the public with an intent to pursue them regarding their product, idea or company. Their job is to influence opinion and behaviour of the audience. Their job is to bring accomplishment to their client by using all forms of media channels.

career_opportunities.title: Social Media
career_opportunities.description: Journalism has changed with the emergence of social media. Websites such as Facebook, Twitter, and Linked-In now serve as news sources for many of their followers.  Degree in Journalism will help you secure the most sought-after jobs in social media.

career_opportunities.title: Investigative Journalist
career_opportunities.description: Investigative journalist does an in-depth investigation of an event or situation. Their main focus is to present a part of information that someone is trying to hide. Investigative reporters are behind many of the reforms that we see today.

career_opportunities.title: Sports Journalism
career_opportunities.description: With sports arena growing in recent years, sports journalist has a major role in the news media organisation. As a sports journalist, you can handle various job duties such as reporting game statistics, interviewing players & coaches.  A sports journalism career is sure to be an exhilarating one.

career_opportunities.title: Freelance Writer.
career_opportunities.description: Unlike earlier scenario where a journalist would become part of a particular publication, now more and more writers are opting for freelancing. They are self-employed and thus their own boss. They work for different publications for short period of time. The more diverse a writer is, he/she is paid better in the industry.

career_opportunities.title: Newspaper Reporter
career_opportunities.description: News reporter or a Correspondent, they gather news worthy information to inform people about the important events taking place around them. They gather information from various resources and may work in a specific beat according to their writing style.

career_opportunities.title: Foreign Correspondent
career_opportunities.description: Foreign correspondents report primarily from a foreign location. They provide their own perspective of the event taking place. They are supposed to be up to date about regions history, current events and culture.

work_description: Investigate, collect, verify and present information in an organised and objective manner Present/ develop or read news on television, radio, magazines or newspapers Be attentive to happenings in the society Build a network of reliable sources for authentic information Work in a team of reporters, writers, editors, photographers, technicians, etc. Take part in interviews, conferences, discussions on different perspectives Observe and evaluate things critically Communicate with people through fluency in speaking as well as writing

career_opportunities.title: Video Jockey
career_opportunities.description: VJs should have an in-depth knowledge about the latest trends in music. Along with introducing music video on Television, they also give some background information about the music being played. They bridge the gap between the audience and musician. Some of them specialize in a particular area or genre of music.

career_opportunities.title: Radio Jockey
career_opportunities.description: A Radio Jockey (or RJ) similar to video jockeys entertains listeners through the medium of radio.  Each have their own style. It is a medium where there is no face to face interaction therefore it is important for Radio jockeys to engage audience by being witty, spontaneous and creative.  They usually write their own scripts. RJ's may have odd hours of duty.

career_opportunities.title: Disc Jockey
career_opportunities.description: A Disc Jockey is someone who plays recorded song. The making of a Club Disc Jockey requires the knowledge of the mood of the intended audience, the performance setting, the preferred medium, and the development of sound manipulation.

work_description: Engage in one/two sided conversation with people Present latest music and related information via radio or video Indulge in making important announcements or in anchoring various shows Organise the content through writing of the scripts Be talkative,  lively, fluent, tactful and captivating to the audience Operate different software programmes and equipments Work on feedback given by seniors and the audience

career_paths.description: Pursue working as a Editor/ Writer / Copywriter

Pros: You can inspire and motivate people through your words. Your work impact masses, which follows with work satisfaction. There is no time bound for a writer as career option. Even if you're 70, with no scope of working in corporate sectors, you can write as a freelancer and write your own story. You get to travel a lot for research based extensive articles.
Cons: Quality of writing is quite subjective and entails a lot of pressure to please everyone with your work. Criticism is a major part of this profession; 10 people can give you the 5 star rating but there will always be one who will write a scathing review and take you down. Job stability and remuneration is low compared to other professions. Working hours can be rigorous and would demand you to even work in weekends.

career_opportunities.title: EDITORIAL ASSISTANTS
career_opportunities.description: With an attention to detail and a flair of writing and verbal skills, a person can do well in this filed. Work of an editorial assistant comprises of writing and editing copy, proofreading and checking the accuracy of the article.  Editorial assistants take on increasing editorial responsibilities compared to others in the company starting from handling overflow from the copy desk, to assisting editors and reporters.

career_opportunities.title: COPYEDITORS
career_opportunities.description: The job of a copy editor is to present information without any mistake. They correct punctuations, grammatical mistakes, spelling so on and so forth. Copy editors work in organisations such as advertising agency, magazines, newspaper and websites.

career_opportunities.title: WRITER/REPORTER
career_opportunities.description: While reporters report in public, writers do their work in private. A reporter has to be someone who knows how to attract attention of the audience in a public place within a short period of time. Reporters engage in the direct communication with the public and gather their information. Reporters are often constrained by time and words whereas writers have no constrain to let their imagination flow.

career_opportunities.title: MANAGING EDITOR
career_opportunities.description: Managing director oversee the entire process from scratch and wear several hats. They assign work to the staff. They put forth their idea to the other team members who can then execute his/her vision. The managing director reports directly to the Editor in chief.

career_opportunities.title: EXECUTIVE & SENIOR WRITERS
career_opportunities.description: Executive editors and senior editors typically set editorial policy, write opinion pieces, and manage teams of editors. As with all types of editing, the foundation is writing, even most executive editors got started in writing. They oversee the content and intervene to enforce quality standards and style rules when necessary. They also plan budgets, set deadlines, and watch market trends.

career_opportunities.title: FREELANCERS
career_opportunities.description: Although freelancers are self- employed and have the choice to work in different publication house simultaneously but freelancing requires time and commitment. The more versatile a writer is, more are the chances of getting hired by different publication house.

work_description: Prepare writing material for publication Develop idea and concept to cater to the needs of the clients Write articles, stories, slogans, one liners, tag lines, etc. Check for right language and correct grammar Collect information from standard sources Promote the ideals of an organisation through words and writings Give equal importance to art and imagery to captivate the viewers

Cons: Stressful job as it requires good networking connection with good convincing skills. It is a broad field and needs people to be adept for multi-taking People who are introvert would find this job strenuous.

career_opportunities.title: Account Coordinator or pr Coordinator
career_opportunities.description: PR coordinator or Account Coordinator make use of various media channels to publicise their organisation to the public. The work involves projects such as clipping newspapers, assisting in research, maintaining a list of media contacts, and coordinating mailings of press packets to the media.

career_opportunities.title: Account Supervisor
career_opportunities.description: An account supervisor often does similar work handled by the account executive, but they'll oversee other staff members assigned to the account as well. The account supervisor oversees PR accounts, often managing the account executives and account coordinators.

career_opportunities.title: Media Relations Manager
career_opportunities.description: In media relations, the person who represents a particular brand and has to pitch information to the reporters in such a manner to get them interested in their idea and have it publicised. Media relation manager should know what the journalist are looking for and hook them to their ideas.

career_opportunities.title: Director, vp
career_opportunities.description: Director, VP are responsible for managing the firm and look after the communication strategies. He/she also has to be active in thinking up new communication services which he/she can sell to the existing clients. Within agencies, a director or vice president works closely with younger staff to train and mentor them.

career_opportunities.title: Government pr Departments
career_opportunities.description: The person involved in this department plays a role of a mediator between the government and the public. Government agencies call their public relations departments "public affairs" offices. In these roles, a person translates government policy for the public and help communicate the public's concerns back to the government.

career_opportunities.title: Self-Employment
career_opportunities.description: After gaining knowledge of the concerned field one can become self- employed in this field. Many organisations often outsource the PR function, relying on outsiders to handle their needs-either an agency or a PR consultant.

work_description: Same as a link between a client/ organisation and the audience Promote a client/ organisation among general public through media, press releases, logos, images, websites, social networking, etc. Conduct/ organize sponsor meetings, conferences, speech and interviews to gain popularity Remain up to-date with latest social, economic and political trends and work accordingly Reflect the brand's  image and identity through one's personality Develop strategies for the client/ organisation to reach out to the masses Highlight the benefits of an organisation and its products and offerings Deal with different kinds of people and their queries Work with patience, intellect and tact while dealing with large scale audience

Pros: You get to work as a freelancer or work from home. You can work from any place any time. They are in great demand especially in Business and Marketing field. Thus, you earn a lot of money. With time, your writing capabilities, vocabulary and language fluency improves.
Cons: There is a lot of competition involved and thus, you have to be best in your own way. Although, the job is quite flexible, however, you have to stick to your deadlines. Content writing can sometimes become very dull and monotonous job.

career_opportunities.title: Web Content Writer
career_opportunities.description: Web Content Writers compose content for online consumption. As a web content writer, you have to write information about the company, how does the company works, product/services, blogs/articles, information about the team members, customer testimonials, email marketing and so on. They are expected to create content that is optimized for the web. As a writer, you must break things down into short paragraphs, with headers if necessary, use bullet points and highlight important words or phrases. Mostly, web content writers are freelancers, however, a lot of companies offer full-time jobs as well.

career_opportunities.title: Freelancers
career_opportunities.description: As a freelancer, your roles and responsibilities depend upon which organization you are working with. Your work ranges from social media engagement to content development to email marketing and collateral development. In Social Media Engagement, you have to create and post  informative content on various Social Media platforms and manage them. For Content Development, you have to research, create engaging blogs, promote and share blogs on platforms like Quora, Medium etc. You have to edit and proofread content as well. Email Marketing would include creating and managing various email campaigns, including the template designs, calls-to-action, and content used in our email. Collateral Development include creating marketing collaterals such as Posters, Smart Fliers/Brochures, Videos, White Papers, Customer Case Studies, Student Testimonials etc.

career_opportunities.title: Creative Content Writer and Editor
career_opportunities.description: Creative Content Writers and Editors are hired by various publishing houses. You have write current news, blogs/articles on trendy topics, reviews and so on. They are also involved in composing statement of purpose, letters of recommendations, resumes, application essays, scholarship letters, motivation letters and so on. items.description: Applied Arts is the art of producing objects, which are aesthetic, utilitarian and also easy to use for people. Hence, these artists apply creative arts to practical use. It is about combining artistic vision with commercial need. Work of an applied artist can be seen in most basic objects such as table, chair, utensils and also in complex objects like smart phones, microwave, food processor amongst many others. Applied arts is often confused with fine arts. Fine Arts forms the basis for applied arts but it requires much more than that. Various fields in applied arts include graphic arts, architecture, industrial designing, decorative arts, jewelry, photography etc. Selection to some universities for bachelor of fine arts and applied arts is made on the basis of an aptitude test consisting of drawing, creative composition in painting, sculpture in clay and graphic design. There are many universities that provide bachelor's degree in applied arts or one can also pursue bachelors in fine arts with honors in applied arts. Job prospects are good after graduation. Applied Arts professionals take up jobs in sectors like animation, advertising companies, dance studios, television, software companies, magazines, digital media etc. Trending Field: Animation, Graphic Designer, Advertising etc.

items.description: Performing arts is an art form where the artists express themselves in front of audience through their physical abilities like body movements, facial expressions, vocals and gestures. Performing arts is divided into three art forms namely, music, dance and drama. Music consists of knowing the theories of music, notes, principles of singing and composing music. Dance, on the other hand is the rhythmic movement of body in sync with the background sound and music. Drama comprises of the depiction of a story through the amalgamation of dance and music along with use of gestures, language, speech and facial expressions. Apart from the basic academic requirement, a person should be interested in the particular art form along with enough talent and skills to pursue it as a career. India is the largest producer of films all over the world and our culture has always cherished different art forms, which continues till date. There are many institutes and universities that provides education in performance at certificate level, diploma level, bachelor's and master's level. Minimum requirement for certificate courses is Xth board certificate; while for diploma and bachelor's level it is 10+2 board certificate. If one wants to study at the master's level, bachelor's degree in relevant subjects is mandatory. Performing art has a lot of scope in todays time and age. One can be placed in theatre groups, entertainment companies, television, as well as the film industry or work independently as freelancers.

items.description: Cabin Crew can be an excellent career choice if travelling across the world and interacting with new people excites you. Cabin crew are the in-flight members that make passengers comfortable while they are flying to their destinations. They look after the passengers boarding, seats, luggage, food and basic requirements along with their safety by introducing them to certain safety measures. They also need to provide a written report about all the records of the flight, which includes sales report about the food and other products, and an account of any unusual experiences. Training in cabin crew services include the study of the profession, passenger handling, in-flight procedures and emergencies, duties after landing, flight evaluation, dealing with passengers with special needs, food and beverage services among others. To become a member of cabin crew one has to be physically fit and attractive. Some airlines have a specific requirement in terms of weight and height. Candidates should also possess good communication and interpersonal skills with the right amount of tactfulness. Selection is usually on the basis of an interview followed by a group discussion. The candidates are eligible to apply after completing class 12th. Before starting work as a professional, one is required to gain some basic knowledge about the job through a course that lasts for around 6 months to a year.  A degree in hotel management is recommended for fast track movement and good growth potential. Recruiters include all the leading International and Domestic Airlines such as Singapore Air, Emirates, Jet Airways, Air India, Indigo etc.

items.description: Hotel Management is emerging to be one of the most lucrative careers in today's age. The hospitality industry has tremendously expanded over the years, which has created a lot of opportunities for the people. A good manager should have good communication skills along with organizational skills to coordinate among different departments. The various fields under hotel management include hotel & restaurant management, cruise ship management, hospital administration, hotel and tourism association, airline catering and cabin services, club management, etc. One can apply for hotel management on the basis of an entrance exam followed by a personal interview. National Council for Hotel Management and Catering Technology conducts the leading entrance exam on a yearly basis. Premium hospitality chains like Taj, Oberoi and ITC have their own hospitality programs and separate selection criteria. There are also several private colleges and institutes, which have their own, entrance exams. The basic requirement for this degree is minimum of 50% marks in 10+2 level. After clearing the entrance exam one can take a bachelor's degree in hotel management or in travel and tourism. Diploma courses are also available which lasts for 6 months to 3 years. Top recruiters include Oberoi Group of Hotels, ITC Group of Hotels, Ambassador Group of Hotels, Indian Hotels Company Limited etc.

items.description: The civil service system is the backbone of the administrative machinery of the country. The Union Public Service Commission conducts a nationwide competitive examination for recruitment to various Civil Services of the Government of India. Civil Services offer an attractive and challenging career to the ambitious, aspiring and the talented youth of the country. The wide variety of jobs within the fold of the Civil Services have relatively greater sphere of authority and power than any other services in India. It is considered to be one of the toughest examination in India with success rate of 0.1%-0.3% with more than 900,000 applicants. The challenging aspect of this exam is that aspirants must complete a three-stage process, requiring in depth knowledge, rational thinking, drafting skills, creativity, language competency, a can do and empathetic personality. The candidate applying for civil services examination must hold a degree of any central, state or deemed university. There are certain restrictions on age limit and number of attempts. Jobs in civil services are symbols of great power, social recognition and affluence. A wide variety of work domains are associated with civil services, like maintenance of law and order, developmental work, disaster management, representing India on international forums, administration, and empowerment of marginalized sections of society etc. Trending fields: Indian Administrative Services, Indian Foreign Service, Indian Police Service.

A third option is railroad engineer or the engine driver.

career_opportunities.description: The station master and the assistant station master are in- charge of the entire daily schedule of the trains arriving at and leaving from a particular station. They coordinate among the various departments such as signals and operations in order to ensure a smooth management and delivery of services. Since this requires a lot of work, big stations may have more than one station master.

career_opportunities.title: Indian Legal Service cadre of Legal Advisors in the Main Secretariat and Branch Secretariats at Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai and Bangalore
career_opportunities.description: The Department advice the Ministries on legal matters including interpretation of the Constitution and the laws, conveyancing and engagement of counsel to appear on behalf of the Union of India in the High Courts and subordinate courts where the Union of India is a party. Conduct of cases in the Supreme Court and the High Courts on behalf of the Central Government and on behalf of the Governments of States participating in the Central Agency Scheme. The Department is also administratively in-charge of the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal and the Law Commission of India. The Department is also administratively concerned with all the matters relating to the Indian Legal Service. It is further connected with the appointment of Law Officers namely the Attorney General of India, the Solicitor General of India and the Additional Solicitor Generals of India.

career_opportunities.title: Indian Legal Service cadre of Law Officers in the Law Commission of India
career_opportunities.description: Law Commission of India it is an executive body established by an order of the Government of India. Its major function is to work for legal reforms. The Commission is established for a fixed tenure and works as an advisory body to the Ministry of Law and Justice. It is required to undertake extensive research and study deeply the various matters related to the law given to it either by Central Government or suo-motu. Review the existing laws in the country for their improvement and suggest Government reforms on those matters for their productive results. Study and research various matters related to the country and problems faced by it and put forward the results before the Government for enacting new legislation. To continuously make reform for reducing the high cost of litigation incurred by people and state, eliminating long time taken delivering justice and to make procedures easier to shorten the time taken.

career_opportunities.description: A government attorney is an attorney that works in the different branches of the government. Depending on where they work, government attorneys handle a range of legal issues that affect the city, the state, or the federal government. The work of government advocate include: Representing the government in court; Providing legal services that are in the interest of the public; Enforcing local and city ordinances; Providing assistance to other governmental agencies; Preparing legal opinions for matters pending before the court.

work_description: •  Law Commission. • Administratively in-charge of the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal and the Law Commission of India. • Conducting cases in the Supreme Court and the High Courts on behalf of the Central Government and on behalf of the Governments of States participating in the Central Agency Scheme. • Giving advice to Ministries on legal matters including interpretation of the Constitution and the laws, conveyancing and engagement of counsel to appear on behalf of the Union of India in the High Courts and subordinate courts where the Union of India is a party.

career_opportunities.description: RLC© is the authority under Minimum Wages Act. They decide cases of payment of wages less than minimum rate of wages fixed, filed before them, as provided under sec. 20 of the M.W.Act. They rae certifying officers, under IE (SO) Act, for the certification of the Draft Standing Orders, submitted under the I.E (SO) Act. Being thehead of the region, RCL is not only in charge of day-to-day administration but also has to discharge many statutory duties relating to enforcement and industrial relations, including those of Conciliation Officer under the I.D. Act.

career_opportunities.title: Assistant Labour Commissioner
career_opportunities.description: ALC intervene and prevent the industrial disputes and maintain harmonious Industrial Relations. They decide the claim cases filed before them under the payment of Gratuity Act (sec. 3) and Authorities under the Equal remuneration Act (section 7). As Registering and Licensing Officers under the Contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act, they grant licenses to the contractors and Registration certificate to the Principal Employers. in addition ALCs have to do verification of Trade Union Membership in the establishment wherever required in respect of industries, which have accepted code of discipline, statutory verification in Banks and ad-hoc verification in major ports.

career_opportunities.title: Labour Enforcement Officer
career_opportunities.description: A Labour Enforcement Officer is responsible for implementation of different laws in the state, inspection of establishments and handling issues related to the labour department. He is responsible for fixing and revision of Minimum Wages under Minimum Wages Act, 1948 (Wages of Labour) every year. In case of ant mishappenings the Labour Enforcement Officer has the control of all officers and staff serving in the Labour Employment and Training Department.

work_description: • Assessment of returns • Dealing with the matters connected with the implementation of policy relating to special target groups. • Quasi- judicial work • Registration of establishment • To enforce social security Acts including the building and other Construction Workers Act, 1996 & the Unorganised Workers Social Security Act, 2008 and implementation of various schemes. • To ensure good relationship between  employers and employees through settlement of Industrial Disputes. • To eradicate child labour

items.description: A career in defense forces promises one of the most prestigious and respected positions in the country. The Indian Armed Forces are the military forces of India, which consists of four professional uniformed services: The Indian Army, Indian Air Force, Indian Navy and Indian Coast Guard. The various paramilitary organizations and various inter-service institutions also help the Indian Armed Forces. The Ministry of Defense is responsible for the management of armed forces in India. Armed forces offer very exciting career to young men and women in several fields. Career in the forces promises a life full of adventure. To ensure that appropriate candidates are chosen, a comprehensive selection process is adopted by the armed forces through Service Selection Board (SSB) Interview. Selection procedure involves three phases: Objective test, Interview and medical examination. Candidates applying for Air force and Navy must have Physics and Maths in the +2 level exam. Students can apply after class 12 (NDA) or after graduation (CDS) for defense services. Candidates finally selected by SSB are absorbed by armed forces. Individuals are exposed to various forms of training and promotions at different levels.

career_opportunities.title: Combat Unit
career_opportunities.description: This section of the Indian Army is responsible for going on warfare and fight the enemy forces. These are the ones who are involved in confronting the enemy troops in the battlefield. These combat forces are trained in artillery, infantry, mechanized infantry, armor, operating weapons, territorial corps, defense security corps, pioneer corps. Divisions like Army Armored Corps, Infantry, Mechanized Infantry, and the Regiment of Artillery, Territorial Corps, come under this category of Indian Army. This is a demanding career with a lot of physical as well as mental stamina.

career_opportunities.title: Air Defense
career_opportunities.description: This division of the Indian Army includes the air observation units and protect  the country's Air Space from external attacks like enemy bombings, missiles, etc. In this way, they support other forces as well as other divisions of the Indian Army by guarding the weapons from foreign attacks and provide support to disaster relief, support ground units and work in different terrains, under diverse weather conditions.

career_opportunities.title: Engineering and IT Unit
career_opportunities.description: Corps of Engineer is one of the oldest arms of the Indian Army, which consists of three divisions: Combat Engineers, MES, and Border Roads. These are the ones who, during wartime, are engaged in the work of constructing bridges, helipads, laying land-mine fields, etc. They are also involved in constructing national highways, airfields, and buildings all over the country. The Electrical and Mechanical Engineers (EME) provide technical assistance and are responsible for the infusion of high and latest technology equipment's into the army. Corps of signal are responsible for ensuring that there is electronic and information superiority so that our army can function in the most effective manner. They take care of the IT and Communication system of the Indian army.

career_opportunities.title: Army Service Corps
career_opportunities.description: This division of the Indian Army provides support and service to its other divisions. They do so by being involved in taking care of their health (Army Medical Corps, Army Dental Corps), taking care of logistics (Army Ordnance Corps), taking care of specialized and technical mandate of the animals used by army for various purposes (Remount and Vetenary Corps). They are also involved in training the future officers and soldiers so that they bring valor and laurels to the country (Army Education Corps), processing mails (Army Postal Corps), and providing them with fresh dairy products on a daily basis (Military Farm Services). They are the backbone of the Indian Army.

career_opportunities.title: Education
career_opportunities.description: The work of this department incompases training the new recruited young officers to serve the nation in near future. Every department has education officer who specialize in particular field so as to train officers and give them career advise. Their work is to assess the education need of military staff and then design, develop and implement the modules accordingly.

work_description: Make a contribution towards nation building Support in maintaining internal security of the country Manage security interventions and secure the border Plan maneuvers, assign duties and communicate effectively with other staff Command, train and lead subordinate personnel Monitor the welfare and progress of new recruits Operate and maintain warfare systems, equipments and vehicles Take on specialist duties and skills such as engineering, air traffic control, training and administration Distribute equipment, resources and manpower as per instructions from superiors

career_opportunities.description: These include General Service Officer, Hydrographic Officer, Naval Armament Inspection Officer, Provost Officer, Pilot Officer, Observer Officer, Submarine Officer, Diver Officer, Law Officer, Logistic Officer, and Information Technology branch. This division of Indian Navy is responsible for working as well as fighting the ship, using it during wartime, prepare nautical charts for providing directions as well as planning attacks, be a part of naval onboard operations. Providing training for war in an effective manner, doing an underwater inspection of the ships to check for defects or repairs, legal needs, keep a track of what all is needed, development and maintenance of IT infrastructure in applications also come under the work designated to this branch of the Indian Navy.

career_opportunities.title: Engineering
career_opportunities.description: This branch of Indian Navy opens gates for students interested in Engineering, General Services, Submarine Engineering, Naval Construction. They work with the submarines and are responsible for ensuring that they are in proper working state and are serviceable. They are also involved in the designing, construction, quality control, as well as repair of the naval vessels. Thus, this division deals majorly with ensuring that we have serviceable naval vessels in our dockyards which can defend the country as and when needed as well as are engrossed in ship building and making constant improvements in their design as well as performance and making them more efficient.

career_opportunities.title: Education
career_opportunities.description: If a person is interested in training the youngsters of the nation and make them good Officers and Navy personnels, this is the division that helps in realizing this dream. By being a part of this division of Indian Navy, the person will be holding the responsibility of training the future Officers and sailors for the naval defense of the nation. They specialize in different fields and then train the students in their area of specialization.

career_opportunities.title: Electrical
career_opportunities.description: Warships are just like mini cities which needs everything like people living on land require be that food, water, and even electricity. So this division of Indian Navy takes care of the electrical requirements of the warships. Underwater weapons, radar and radio communication, missile systems are also controlled by them along with computer controlled machinery. They are the ones who make sure that all these systems are performing at the peak level.

career_opportunities.title: Medical

career_opportunities.description: This branch deals with pilots, be it fighter pilots, transport pilots or helicopter pilots. They work not just during wartime, but during peace as well. These are the ones who are involved in raiding enemy bunkers, troops, air force stations, artillery sites, do surveillance, provide support to the infantry, help in disaster relief programs.

career_opportunities.title: Technical Branch
career_opportunities.description: This branch of Indian Air Force handles the technical and mechanical needs and requirements of the Air Force, which are an important asset of the nation. From maintenance to performing to replacing the faulty parts as well as giving suggestions and designing efficient machines also comes under this section of the Air Force.

career_opportunities.title: Ground Duty Branch
career_opportunities.description: This is the branch of the Air Force, which looks into the logistics, administration, accounting, education as well as meteorology departments. They are the ones who manage human as well as financial resources allotted to the Air Force. One can work as an internal auditor, fighter controller, air traffic controller, handling the latest satellite imagery, supervision of inventories, etc.

work_description: Fly combat or fighter planes carrying ammunition and missiles Transport pilots fly planes which carry men and materials Provide air support to a moving army, or for para-dropping men and supplies Fly along with the pilot and guide the aircraft by using the latest avionic equipment Ensure proper maintenance of aircrafts and handle the electronic and communication equipment Deliver logistical, meteorological, educational and administrative support to the flying and technical branches Provide control and advisory services to enable the pilot to conduct flights in total safety Monitor the skies for any potential threat and select the appropriate air defense system Be Responsible for provisioning the aircraft with spares, fuel, armaments, etc

career_opportunities.title: Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF)
career_opportunities.description: The Central Reserve Police Force's mission is to enable the government to effectively and efficiently maintain Rule of Law, Public Order, and Internal Security, as well as to preserve national integrity and promote social harmony and development by upholding the supremacy of the Constitution.

career_opportunities.title: Border Security Force (BSF)
career_opportunities.description: "BSF is a Border Guarding Force, it is a paramilitary force charged with guarding India's land borders with Pakistan and Bangladesh. The BSF has air wing, marine wing, an artillery regiment, and commando units. It currently stands as the world's largest border guarding force. BSF has been termed as the First Line of Defence of Indian Territories"

career_opportunities.title: Central Industrial Security Force (CISF)
career_opportunities.description: The Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) is the country's premier multi-skilled security agency, tasked with providing security to the country's major critical infrastructure installations in a variety of areas. CISF currently provides security for nuclear installations, space establishments, airports, seaports, power plants, sensitive government buildings, and heritage monuments.

career_opportunities.title: Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB)
career_opportunities.description: The sole goal of achieving 'Total security preparedness' in remote border areas in order to perform a'stay-behind' role in the event of a war." SSB is now spread across Uttarakhand, UP, Bihar, West Bengal, Sikkim, Assam, and Arunachal Pradesh's international border.

career_opportunities.title: Indo Tibetan Border Police (ITBP)
career_opportunities.description: The ITBP is a specialized mountain force, with the majority of officers and men being professionally trained mountaineers and skiers. ITBP has carried out numerous rescue and relief operations across the country as the first responder to natural disasters.

career_opportunities.title: National Security Guard (NSG)
career_opportunities.description: The National Security Guard (NSG) is an anti-terrorist force. As a Federal Contingency Force, the National Security Guard has been tasked with dealing with all aspects of terrorism in any part of the country. It is a task-oriented force with two complementary elements: the Special Action Group (SAG), which consists of Army personnel, and the Special Ranger Groups (SRG), which consists of personnel drawn from Central Armed Police Forces/State Police Forces.

career_opportunities.title: Railway Protection Force (RPF)
career_opportunities.description: Railway Protection Force (RPF) is one of the security forces of India. It is tasked with protecting property and passengers of the Indian Railways. It is the only Central Armed Police Force(CAPF) with powers similar to regular state police forces.  They perform many roles including the provision of internal security under the control of the army through the conduct of counterinsurgency and border security operations, provision of aid to the civilians in times of emergency, and the provision of communications, medical assistance and education in remote areas.

career_opportunities.title: Assam Rifles (AR)
career_opportunities.description: They perform many roles including the provision of internal security under the control of the army through the conduct of counterinsurgency and border security operations, provision of aid to the civilians in times of emergency, and the provision of communications, medical assistance and education in remote areas.

work_description: • Other Functions include Counter Insurgency Operations, Anti Naxal Operations, Internal Security Duties, VIP Protection, Lead Intelligence Agency, Security To Diplomatic Missions Abroad, UN Peacekeeping Operations, Disaster Management, Civic Action Nodal agency for UN Police Missions, etc. • Prevent trans-border crimes, smuggling, unauthorized entry into or exit from the territory of India and to prevent any other illegal activity. • Provide security to sensitive installations, persons at security risk. • Restore and preserve order in any area in the event of disturbance therein. • Safeguard the security of borders of India and promote a sense of security among the people living in border areas

items.description: Marketing is the management process responsible for identifying, anticipating and satisfying customer requirements profitably. Professionals in this field are the brains behind all ads and campaigns; and they're responsible for bringing products and services into the public consciousness. Careers in marketing require knowledge of market research, consumer behavior, sales, visual arts and general marketing. With new products being developed all the time and the economy moving to a global stage, the demand of marketers is at an all time high. A bachelor degree along with an MBA with marketing specialization is recommended for getting high paid marketing jobs. Besides MBA programs, BBM  or BBA degree holders can also find various positions in the field of marketing. Top recruiters include companies from across the industry like P & G, ITC, HUL in FMCG, Maruti and Hyundai in Automotive, AC Nielsen in Market Research and Google, LinkedIn and Facebook in the Social Media space. Trending Fields : Digital Marketing, Brand Marketing

career_opportunities.title: Digital Marketing
career_opportunities.description: The hectic life schedule that people follow these days has led to the growth of e- commerce. There is a huge demand for digital marketing which involves the promotion of products or brand via electronic media like internet, mobile apps, mobile messaging, etc. The marketers work involves monitoring things such as what is to be viewed, the content, the visual graphics, and for what time duration.

career_opportunities.title: Marketing Research
career_opportunities.description: This is the most important stage before any product is launched in the market. It is essential for any company to understand the market. Market research enables the company to understand their consumers, their needs, their purchasing habits and how they view the product.

career_opportunities.title: Advertising
career_opportunities.description: When a company plans to launch their product in the market, advertising becomes an essential part of brand promotion. It is paid announcement which is done so as to gain customer?-?s attention. Various forms of media is used for promotion of product such as Electronic media (Radio/TV), Print media (Newspaper/Magazine), direct mail, etc. Advertising is done to create brand reinforcement and brand identity.

career_opportunities.title: Marketing Strategist
career_opportunities.description: In order to achieve the maximum profit and sustain the business, marketing strategy is used at various levels of product. This involves both short term as well as long term strategies based on the market research and taking company?-?s goal and objectives into account.

career_opportunities.title: Brand Management
career_opportunities.description: Brand management is crucial for an organization in order to create a reputation of their brand in the marketplace. It consists of various important factors such as brand positioning, cost, customer satisfaction and being aware of the competitors. A good brand management not only increase the sale of the product being advertised, but other products which are associated with the brand.

career_opportunities.title: Integrated Market Communication
career_opportunities.description: Integrated marketing communication (IMC), as the name says, it integrated various forms of marketing methods in order to maximize the communication impact on the target consumer, thus increasing the sale of the product.

career_opportunities.title: Public relations/ Corporate Communication
career_opportunities.description: Public relations department act as a bridge between the customers and the organization. They are the spokesperson for the company and are involved in creating a favorable brand image. They work with press releases to promote new products or to keep the investment community informed of business partnerships, financial results, or other company news.

career_opportunities.title: Direct Marketing
career_opportunities.description: Direct marketing or Database marketing is used to reach customers directly using their phone numbers, email ids, purchase histories, etc. and communicate about new product or services.

work_description: Identify, develop, or evaluate marketing strategy to reach the target audience Formulate, direct, or coordinate marketing activities or policies to promote products or services Deploy successful marketing campaigns and own their implementation from conceiving idea to execution Produce valuable and engaging content for blogs and websites that attract the target audience Build strategic relationships with a range of stakeholders including customers, vendors, agencies and hike partner organizations Consult product development personnel on product specifications such as design, color, or packaging Be in charge of marketing budget and allocate/invest funds wisely Measure and report performance of marketing campaigns and assess against target goals Negotiate contracts with vendors or distributors to manage product distribution
