career_opportunities.title: Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
career_opportunities.description: Search engine optimization is a technique, or strategy to increase the number of visitors to a website by obtaining a high-ranking placement in the search result pages of a search engine (SERP) including Google, Yahoo, Bing, Firefox, and others.

career_opportunities.title: Email Marketing
career_opportunities.description: It is also known as direct marketing wherein commercial message is sent to a group of people using email. Unlike spam, direct email marketing reaches those target audience to inform them about company?-?s products and services.

career_opportunities.title: Mobile Marketing
career_opportunities.description: Mobile marketing is marketing on or with a mobile device, such as a cell phone. It is any marketing activity conducted through a ubiquitous network to which consumers are constantly connected using a personal mobile device.

career_opportunities.title: Social Media Marketing
career_opportunities.description: It is a form of Internet marketing which is done so as to increase the brand exposure and broaden customer reach. Various social networking websites are used as a marketing tool, such as Facebook, twitter, Instagram, etc.

career_opportunities.title: Content Marketing
career_opportunities.description: Content marketing is a strategic marketing approach focused on creating and distributing valuable, relevant, and consistent content to attract and retain a clearly-defined audience ?-" and, ultimately, to drive profitable customer action. Content marketing?-?s purpose is to attract and retain customers by consistently creating and curating relevant and valuable content with the intention of changing or enhancing consumer behavior.

career_opportunities.title: Affiliate Marketing
career_opportunities.description: It is a type of performance-based marketing in which a business rewards one or more affiliates for each visitor or customer brought by the affiliate's own marketing efforts.

career_opportunities.title: Product Research
career_opportunities.description: Product research is done to gather information about the individual product. It studies the product from its initital stage to marketing of the product. It studies the size, shape, colour, quality, packaging, brand name and price of the product. It also looks into the product modification, product innovation, product life cycle, etc. As per the need and want of the consumer, the product is modified (changed) as per the needs and wants of the consumers.

career_opportunities.title: Consumer Research
career_opportunities.description: Consumer research is done to understand consumer behaviour. It studies the consumer needs, their buying motives, atitutde, age, sex, income, demographic location, etc. This data is used to take decisions about the product, its price, place and promotion.

career_opportunities.title: Packaging Research
career_opportunities.description: Packaging research is important part of product research, which is done to attract attention of the target audience towards their product.  It looks into the  the quality of the product, makes packaging interesting, reduces cost of the packaging by selecting suitable packaging material, etc.

career_opportunities.title: Pricing Research
career_opportunities.description: Pricing Research studies the pricing of the product. It fixes the price for the product by comparing the companies price with the competitor's price. It also fixes the discount and commission and predicts the future price trends by studying the market price trends.

career_opportunities.title: Advertising Research
career_opportunities.description: As the shelf life of advertisement is low, so the main objective of the advertising research is to decide on the advertising message, layout, copy, slogan, headline, etc. which is catchy and sets them apart from their competetiors and make the advertisement memorable for the audience. Apart from this it also sets the advertising budget and selects a suitable media for advertising. It also evaluates the effectiveness of advertising and other sales promotion techniques.

career_opportunities.title: Sales Research
career_opportunities.description: Sales research studies the selling activities of the company. It studies the sales outlets, sales territories, sales forecasting, sales trends, sales methods, effectiveness of the sales force, etc.

career_opportunities.title: Distribution Research
career_opportunities.description: Distribution research studies the channels of distribution. It selects a suitable channel for the product. It fixes the channel objectives. It identifies the channel functions like storage, grading, etc. It evaluates the competitor's channel.

career_opportunities.title: Policy Research
career_opportunities.description: It studies the company's policies and evaluates the effectiveness of the marketing policies, distribution policies, sales policies, pricing policies, inventory policies, etc. and thus  makes the necessary changes in it, if required.

career_opportunities.title: International Marketing Research
career_opportunities.description: Data of international market is collected to help their product entre and sustain in the international market. It collects data about the consumers behaviour, their economy, political sitiation, etc. as well as the data about the  foreign competitors which is useful for the exporters.

career_opportunities.title: Motivation Research
career_opportunities.description: Motivation research studies consumers' buying motives. It studies those factors that motivate consumers to buy a product. It mainly finds out, Why the consumers buy the product? It also finds out the causes of consumer behaviour in the market.

career_opportunities.title: Market Research
career_opportunities.description: In order to increase the sale, market research is conducted which studies the  market competition, market trends, buying habbits, etc. It fixes the sales territories and sales quotas as well as estimates the demand for new products and does the sales forecast.

career_opportunities.title: Media Research
career_opportunities.description: Media research studies various advertising media. The different advertising media are television (TV), radio, newspapers, magazines, the internet, etc. Media research studies the merits and demerits of each media. It selects a suitable medium for advertising. It does media planning. It also studies, media cost. It helps in sales promotion and to avoid wastage in advertising.

career_opportunities.title: Account Director/ Manager
career_opportunities.description: An account director is a person who establishes a link between the client and the creative team. He/ she works with both in ternal teams and customers to ensure clear communication. They deliver creative work that meets then clients' needs.

career_opportunities.title: Marketing Director/ Manager
career_opportunities.description: A marketing director makes sure that the marketing process is consistent and flawless across different advertising campaigns, and he also ensures the client's brand is recognizable and appealing. Marketing director establish cost parameters and sales estimates.

career_opportunities.title: Production Manager
career_opportunities.description: Production managers are responsible for handling logistics and coordinating & ensuring the orderly flow. They assure that tracking, reporting, and billing are functioning optimally.

career_opportunities.title: Brand Strategist
career_opportunities.description: A brand startegist analyse current market research data and trends. They advice on and developing practical solutions for marketing plans. They also define brand elements and tone. The brand strategist aims to ensure a compelling brand message to the right target audience.

career_opportunities.title: Digital Strategist
career_opportunities.description: A digital strategist plays a significant role in the successful planning and implementation of digital marketing strategies, taking into consideration offline marketing efforts as well. They provide solutions based on consumer insight and data.

career_opportunities.title: Media Buyer
career_opportunities.description: A media buyer's role is to classify the most suitable media platforms to market a brand, product or service. He/ she ensures that the campaigns reach the highest number of people. Besides placements, media buyers also negotiate the price for all advertisements.

career_opportunities.title: Creative director
career_opportunities.description: Creative directors are the final decision makers regarding a copy or design. They lead a creative team of art directors, designers, and copywriters. They work with sales team and marketers to create the concept for the product. The creative director guides a creative team.

career_opportunities.title: Art Director
career_opportunities.description: An art director is responsible for outlining a product's, services campaign's, or a brand's visual characteristics. The art director is responsible for the visuals, aesthetics, and artistic aspects of the project. He/ she also directs others to develop the layouts of the artworks required.

career_opportunities.title: Graphic Designer
career_opportunities.description: Graphic designers bring ideas to reality and create visual concepts on the art directors' design direction.

career_opportunities.title: Design Illustrator
career_opportunities.description: Illustrators create 2-D drawings which are used in advertisements, books, magazines, packaging, greeting cards, newpapers, etc.

career_opportunities.title: Image Retoucher
career_opportunities.description: Image retouchers are responsible for enhancing the appearance of a picture to suit a project's specifications. They are incharge of combining images, consolidating or eliminating backgrounds, playing with colors, and anything that creates an entirely new copy.

career_opportunities.title: UX+ UI Designer
career_opportunities.description: A User experience (UX) designer is responsible for creating how aproduct will function. They are also responsible for mapping out the functionality of every screen that a user will interact with. A User Interface (UI) designer is responsible for creating the look nad feel of a product and taking the charted out user experience and then designing the visual factors.

career_opportunities.title: Web Developer
career_opportunities.description: Web developer create programs and applications for the internet. They can develop a website from scratch with layouts, features, and functions.

career_opportunities.title: Web Designer
career_opportunities.description: A web designer is required to make websites more aesthetically appealing and easy-to-use. These professionals need to be connected with the trends and online consumer preferences that usually change at a fast pace.

career_opportunities.title: Copywriter
career_opportunities.description: A copywriter develops concepts and ideas for advertising campaigns. They also write the text used in promotional campaigns.

items.description: Sales function forms the core of every business, whether it produces a physical product such as a car or tennis shoes, or offers a service, such as electrical testing or psychic healing. A link between the producer and the customer is necessary so that the customer is aware of and has access to the product; which is achieved by sales professionals. Selling of the products is the main objective of almost all firms. For this every firm small or big requires a professional often known as Sales Manager who takes care of the sales. Individuals from all backgrounds and all education levels enter the sales industry.  MBA degree in Sales is preferred over other degrees by employers. Employment opportunities for sales people exist across a wide spectrum of sectors, the most popular of which in terms of the number of people employed, are: FMCG, Media, Pharmaceutical, Automotive and Retail. Trending fields: FMCG Industry, Pharmaceutical Industry, Automotive Industry

career_opportunities.description: Sales people employed by pharmaceutical companies informs doctors about the drugs avaialable in their company and pursue them to use their companies medicine. Their work is to generate sale revenue by providing right product to the right doctors.

career_opportunities.title: Automobile Industry
career_opportunities.description: A salesperson in the automobile industry work with the manufacturers who deals with cars, commercial vehicles and other product related to automobile industry. Their task involves understanding the customer needs and specific  requirements and guide them towards the most appropriate product.

career_opportunities.title: FMCG Industry
career_opportunities.description: Retail industry where same or similar products are offered to the customers, a good sales person can make all the difference. A success or failure of a product is dependent on how well prepared a sales person is, and can gain maximum benefit from the product featured.

career_opportunities.title: Retail Industry
career_opportunities.description: People who pursue careers in retail are required to engage with the customers and explain the benefit of the merchandise in order to help them make an informed decision. Their objective is to improve sales figures and boost revenue.

career_opportunities.title: Information Technology Industry
career_opportunities.description: This industry is particularly suitable for people with a background of IT. Sales professionals in this industry liaison with technical and purchasing staff to understand clients IT related requirements.

career_opportunities.title: Finance & Banking Industry
career_opportunities.description: Sales professionals in this sector would be selling a range of products such as pensions, life insurance, mortgages and saving schemes, as either an independent financial advisor or as a representative of a financial institution.

career_opportunities.title: Real State Industry
career_opportunities.description: They are engaged in work such as like renting, buying, or selling property for clients. Perform duties such as interviewing prospective clients, studying property listings, accompanying clients to property site, discussing conditions of sale, and drawing up real estate contracts.

items.description: A career in Management makes students familiar with knowledge of business, trade, management techniques, industry, basics of economics, fiscal policies, industrial policies, share market, stock markets, etc. Management studies teaches one how to manage a business professionally. With increasing competition in the field, huge number of colleges providing management related courses have mushroomed across the country offering traditional specializations such as Finance, Marketing, Sales, Operations and Human Resources to the trending specializations like Health Care Management, Sports Management, Rural Management, Fashion Management etc. Students who are keen to take up management as a career option after class 12th can opt for BBA, BBS or BBM for developing a sound base in the field of management education. After graduation, one may opt for an MBA degree in a specialized field. Management is a career option which can also be pursued after almost any graduation degree such as Law, Engineering, Medicine, Social Sciences among others. Management is one of the most sought after careers because of the lucrative salaries and good future prospects it offers; especially if one graduates from the leading management colleges. Trending Fields: Sports Management, Health Care Management, Operations Management, Human Resource Management, Finance Management

career_opportunities.title: Sales
career_opportunities.description: Sales could be defined as "the holistic business system required to effectively develop, manage, enable, and execute a mutually beneficial, interpersonal exchange of goods, and/or services for equitable value". The main role involved in this profession is showcasing products and services, negotiating sales and providing after sale services through face to face interaction or telephonic communication.

career_opportunities.title: Marketing
career_opportunities.description: Marketing as a career is the best field for people who like to strategize and identify patterns and trends. The various marketing job profiles include - project managers, marketing managers, market analysts, sales managers, etc. Identifying the target market for products or services, developing products, formulating pricing and sales strategies for business growth to increase profitability and to maintain public relations are some of the key roles in this domain.

career_opportunities.title: Supply Chain Management
career_opportunities.description: Supply Chain Management as a career includes planning, procuring, handling, managing and enabling supply of goods and services. Supply chain managers are the purchasers and transportation planners. Careers in SCM are extremely diverse and the sector is continuously shifting, evolving and moving with changing technology & needs of people.

career_opportunities.title: Finance
career_opportunities.description: Finance as an arena is concerned with the management and circulation of money. Role in finance varies from helping corporates and individuals make finance planning decisions to helping businesses raise capital for expansion and running business operations.

career_opportunities.title: Operation Management
career_opportunities.description: Operations management is an intermix of business, finance and technology which is chiefly concerned with planning, organizing and supervising in production, manufacturing or the provision of services. This field is concerned with the physical or technical functions of a firm.

career_opportunities.title: Human Resources
career_opportunities.description: Human resource management is all about management of employees within the organization and maximizing their performance. It involves designing the policies for the effective functioning of organization, managing compensation and benefits, training of employees, maintaining proper labor relations and evaluating employee performance.

career_opportunities.title: Health Care Management
career_opportunities.description: Owing to the rapid growth in the health care sector, health care management is emerging to be one of the most rewarding career paths. A degree in management arms one to play a significant role in hospital management involving activities like ensuring hospitals operations, Efficient supervision in making them financially sound and independent and in creating a patient-centric organization.

career_opportunities.title: Management Consulting
career_opportunities.description: Management consulting is to assist a client to obtain information and advice leading to a realistic and lasting solution of a problem. Consultants think, analyze, brainstorm, cajole and challenge good organizations to become even better by adopting innovative ideas.

career_opportunities.title: Entrepreneurship
career_opportunities.description: A Management degree empowers an individual to embark on an entrepreneurial route. An entrepreneur looks to solve problems through innovative solutions and products. Given the present economic scenario in the country, entrepreneurship is an extremely challenging path. It is emerging as an extremely sought after career path.

career_opportunities.title: Sports Agents
career_opportunities.description: Sports Agent look after their athlete's public relations, business promotion,career progression etc. Sports agent manages the business oppurtunities for the player and acts as a bridge between the player and the club. He/She should have knowledge about financial analysis, business management and investments.

career_opportunities.title: Sports Managers
career_opportunities.description: Sport managers is the spoke person for the athlete They keep in touch with the media to maintain a good image of their client.

career_opportunities.title: Sports Medicine Professional
career_opportunities.description: The responsibility of sports medicine professional is to maintain atheletes mental and physical health. The knowledge of kinesiology, physiology, anatomy and nutrition is applied to sports by them. They often undertake regulatory and legal issues that are associated with professional sports.

career_opportunities.title: Sports Information Director
career_opportunities.description: Sports information director work is similar to that of a public relation personnel. They work encompasses working on press release, organisating conference for atheletes and coaches, updating information about the team on the website etc. The athletic director is the person responsible for administration and oversight of all athletic programs. They also work in colleges and universities.

career_opportunities.title: Sports Marketing Specialist
career_opportunities.description: Sports Marketing specialist coordiantes activities during sports event. Marketing techniques are utilized by the specialist to increase ticket sale during such events. They often work with sponsors for the promotion of their product.

career_opportunities.title: Event or facility managers
career_opportunities.description: Settings and fields where sport event takes place on a regular basis require people to manage them and ensure proper maintainance of the facility and this is undertaken by the facility manager. Their work involves managing the staff  that operates and maintains the venue and also works to book events and negotiate event contracts with sports teams or other organizations.

career_opportunities.title: Sports Journalist / Commentator
career_opportunities.description: With good communication skills and knack for sports one can find avenues to practice the art as commentators, journalists etc.  The emergence of League competitions such as IPL, ISL, IBL, etc. has created abundant career opportunities.

career_opportunities.title: Sports Federations
career_opportunities.description: There are 52 approved National Sports Federations and hundreds of state level and district level federations. These are the organizing and governing bodies of sports in India at various levels. Their responsibility is to promote sports as an industry and help in growth of various aspects.

Pros: The job role of hospital manager involves people interaction as you will be connecting with a large number of people on daily basis. A sense of internal satisfaction will be there as you are involved in an organization where people come to regain their health. It allows you to do varied work such as dealing with patients, managing staff, handling finance etc. as the main aim is to ensure smooth functioning of the hospital
Cons: It’s a difficult job as it requires immense amount of effort and energy throught the day and at night also. As it involves handling various jobs at one particular point of time, internse work pressure comes along with it. The personnel management side of hospital administrator is often the most challenging one.

career_opportunities.title: Managing Manpower in Hospitals
career_opportunities.description: Hospital Management students can be hired in the hospitals as HR managers wherein they will be hiring doctors and other working staff. They are also hired as Nursing directors, medical directors, head of the departments etc. wherein the main job is to maintain the functioning of the hospital, managing outpatients, managing treatment centres and ensuring patient as well as staff healthcare.

career_opportunities.title: Sales & Marketing
career_opportunities.description: As a Hospital Manager, you will be handling all the administrative work such as finances, accounting, marketing etc. They will work more towards the functioning side of it.

career_opportunities.title: Hospital Operations
career_opportunities.description: You will be involved in managing hospital operations and also day to day running of hospital. From managing single department to hospital chains all over the country, one has to keep a check of all.

career_opportunities.title: Academics
career_opportunities.description: Hospital Management also provides with the career opportunities in the field of academics wherein you can become dean, director, lecturer in various colleges and universities of hospital management wherein you will be imparting your knowledge to budding hospital managers.

work_description: Job of Hospital managers involve planning and coordination of various deprtaments in the hospital. Healthcare Managers can be found in a variety of settings within a hospital ranging from human resources to specialized clinical areas to general oversight. A person can be involved in the hiring, finance, accounts etc. in the hospital according to their specialisation and area of interest. Healthcare managers establish policies and frameworks, manage human resources, allocate budgets and other financial resources, submit reports, and maintain and manage IT systems and databases. Managers of all levels need to coordinate with doctors, physicians, nurses, surgeons, health information technicians, pharmacists, and other professionals to ensure patient quality care, treatment, and rehabilitation. Managers have to draw up schedules and address specific needs for the entire staff with the overall focus being patient care.

items.description: Entrepreneurs are leaders willing to take risk and exercise initiative. They look to take advantage of market opportunities often by innovating or improving existing products & services. Developed countries are moving from 'managerial' to 'entrepreneurial' economies. India, as an emerging economy, is ensuring that entrepreneurship is embraced as a career choice for the young. The ecosystem for Entrepreneurship commonly known as Start-Ups is at its brightest. While no specific education or training is required to start a business venture of your own, the odds of success increase exponentially when entrepreneurs have a solid education background. With the popularity of entrepreneurship rising, many universities/ institutes offer programs to groom budding entrepreneurs. These programs are available both at undergraduate (BBS, BBA) and post graduate levels (MBA). Most top business schools also provide courses for entrepreneurship. Entrepreneurs are job creators rather than job seekers. They create products and services. Other than the path of owning one's own business, participating in a family business or starting a partnered venture, entrepreneurs also take up roles in the field of business consulting, sales, research and development, not-for-profit management, and mid-level management. Trending Fields: E-Commerce, M-Commerce, EduTech, FinTech, Healthcare

items.description: A law degree arms one with serious advocacy skills, enabling one to argue in favor of any cause. Lawyers advice clients and provide solutions to legal issues at both private and public level. They interpret laws, rules and regulations and prepare legal documents. They argue and debate at the courts and take decisions on legal matters. As a lawyer one is expected to apply abstract law theories to solve problems of clients in diverse set of situations. India has over twelve lakh lawyers but according to reports only one fifth of them are capable to practice law in the courts. Thus there is a huge demand of well-trained & skilled lawyers. With the increase in the number of premier law colleges in the country and the increasing demand from the industry; a career in law is an extremely lucrative option for the youth. Today ,a huge range of specialization options has also emerged for lawyers such as International Taxation Law, Cyber Law, Environment Law, Sports Management Law, IPR, Aviation Law and Mergers & Acquisitions Law etc. Students interested in making a career in law can either do a 5 years' course straight after 12th class or a three-year law course after graduation in any discipline. After graduation one can further specialize by pursuing an LLM from an Indian or global university/college. People in the field of law, work at various corporate houses, law agencies, law firms, litigation, and administrative services amongst others. Today leading law firms are the most sought after destination for Law Graduates. Some of the top law firms in the country are: Amarchand Mangaldas, AZB & Partners, J Sagar Associates, Khaitan & Co, Luthra & Luthra. Trending Fields: Corporate Law, International Taxation, Cyber Law

Pros: It is a high paying job once you are thorough with the subject. Provides opportunities to help people. Lawyers are always in demand.
Cons: Need to learn a lot of information. Hard decisions to be made during most trials, hence it can be stressful. Ethical and moral issues.

career_opportunities.title: Law Firms
career_opportunities.description: Leading law firms are the most sought after destination for Law Graduates. As part of a law firm, one advises clients about their legal rights and recourses as well as other legal matters. Careers in the leading law firms are characterized by high pay packages and fast career progression. Graduates can work across multiple domains of law or choose to specialize in specific fast growing domains like IPR, Cyber Law etc.

career_opportunities.title: Corporate Counsel
career_opportunities.description: Law graduates work with a company/corporate entity as an in-house legal counsel, advising on legal matters related to its business. An in-house counsel plays an important role in drafting, vetting and negotiating contracts; ensuring and monitoring compliance with rules and laws; and handling legal disputes.

career_opportunities.title: Litigation
career_opportunities.description: Litigation provides a wide range of employment options in both private and public spheres. Here, focus is on appellate work, trial-level practice, civil litigation or criminal cases. Litigators may start with lower entry level salaries than their counterparts in the corporate sector, but can grow at a much faster pace.

career_opportunities.title: Judicial Services/Civil Services
career_opportunities.description: Law Graduates who are looking to be part of the prestigious civil services, can prepare for the Civil Services Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission. Exciting opportunities exists for graduates who wish to contribute towards shaping the future of the country.

career_opportunities.title: Social Work
career_opportunities.description: If social-legal issues excite you, a promising career in Law exists with NGOs and Civil Society Organizations. Law school graduates may get opportunities to work with international organizations such as the United Nations and with international tribunals like International Court of Justice, International Criminal Court etc.

career_opportunities.title: Legal Processing Outsourcing
career_opportunities.description: Legal Processing outsourcing (LPO) is the delegation of core legal functions like making first drafts of cases, compliance work, legal research, etc. to an external counsel. The assigned task is completed on the basis of set parameters and fixed timelines. In this field one can work at a reputed MNCs by pursuing a career in LPO.

career_opportunities.title: Judicial Clerkship
career_opportunities.description: A judicial clerkship is an extremely valuable experience for students interested in either litigation or transactional work; it provides invaluable insights into the workings of the legal system. Law clerks act as legal assistants whose duties vary from court to court and judge to judge.

career_opportunities.title: Media and Law
career_opportunities.description: As professionals, both journalism and law are intertwined as they require superior research and writing skills as well as a critical knowledge of the government and the legal system. Legal journalism covers legal proceedings in courts, arbitration events, criminal matters, etc., which are disseminated to the public. It includes legal publishing and law reporting.

work_description: Meet and consult clients to understand and manage their legal transactions Draft official papers, letters and agreements personalized to the client's specific requirements Suggest clients on legal and law matters according to their case Gather evidence to formulate defense strategy, by means of interviewing clients and witnesses to ascertain the facts Interpret laws, rulings and regulations for individuals and businesses Analyze probable scenarios in cases, using knowledge of legal theory and precedents Negotiate and bargain with clients and other related network partners to achieve the given objective Manage and supervise the execution and drafting of contracts Correspond with clients and conflicting advocates Represent clients in Court during disputes

Pros: • It involves helping others and serving justice. • It is a highly respected and recognized job. • Public prosecutors can become top paid professionals with experience.
Cons: • It can be stressful in the beginning. • It requires long working hours. • There is tough competition in this field.

career_opportunities.title: Assistant Public Prosecutor
career_opportunities.description: Assistant Public Prosecutors examine the charges filed by the police or the investigative agencies and submit the acquittal or discharge. They also examine the evidence and file revisions petitions. They conduct cases in Courts of Metropolitan Magistrate.

career_opportunities.title: Additional Public Prosecutor
career_opportunities.description: Additional Public Prosecutors conduct cases in session courts (criminal courts).

career_opportunities.title: Public Prosecutor
career_opportunities.description: Public Prosecutors conduct cases in high courts and session courts along with Additional Public Prosecutor.

career_opportunities.title: Chief Prosecutor
career_opportunities.description: Chief Prosecutors supervise the functions exercised by Assistant Public Prosecutor in Metropolitan Magistrate Court.

career_opportunities.title: Director of Prosecution
career_opportunities.description: Director of prosecution is appointed by some states to supervise the Department of Public Prosecution.

work_description: • Advise the police regarding the feasibility of proceeding with a case • Defend the rights of the accused and ensure that they get proper justice under the law. • Ensure a speedy trial. • Help the defense counsel decide the quantum of punishment for the accused keeping in mind the facts, evidence and nature of the crime. • Initiate proceedings in courts for declaring an accused a proclaimed offender in case s/he is not traceable. • Liaison with senior advocates for complicated cases. • Obtain search warrants, arrest warrants and police custody remand for interrogation. • Presenting evidence, cross-examining witnesses and arguing case for prosecution • Submit acquittal of the accused in case of evidence.

items.description: In the domain of finance, professionals develop a good understanding of financial management techniques, economic patterns, art of investing money, stock markets, financial planning, corporate finance etc. Finance allows one to apply their understanding of numbers and accounting/ finance concepts to enable business decision making. Career in this domain can be rewarding, intrinsically and monetarily. Today the role of finance professionals varies from helping corporates and individuals make finance planning decisions to helping businesses raise capital for expansion and running business operations. A degree in finance opens a wide domain for employment in areas such as banks, financial institutions, insurance companies, mutual funds, large MNCs, private equity firms, consulting companies and investment companies. Students can pursue graduation and post graduation in finance related disciplines like accounts, commerce, business, economics, statistics etc. and further start work in finance and investment sector. Another option is to obtain technical professional qualification in finance like MBA Finance or obtain CFA Certification etc. to be part of finance industry. Finance graduates are recruited as associates in investment banks, analysts, consultants, tax analysts or researchers in consulting companies, analysts in asset management firms; or budget analysts or project managers or policy analysts in multi national corporations as well as government sector. Generally financial companies look for high motivation skills, excellent communication, presentation, judgment, negotiation and commercial skills from very self-confident and dedicated candidates. Top recruiters includes Private Banks, Investment Firms, Audit Firms, Consulting Firms and Asset Management Firms. Trending fields: Corporate Finance, Private Equity, Investment Banking, Financial Planning

Cons: Getting certification is a long process Work-life balance may get affected due to tediousness of job Can become boring in the long run

career_opportunities.title: Financial planner/Financial Analyst/Financial Consultant
career_opportunities.description: Financial planners help individuals develop plans that will ensure their present and future financial stability. Typically, they review a client's financial goals and generate an appropriate plan for saving and investing that fits the client's individual needs. The plan may focus on wealth preservation or investment growth and may even include estate and tax planning.

career_opportunities.title: Relationship Manager or Agent/Broker
career_opportunities.description: If you love meeting people and nurturing strong working relationships, "client-facing" positions like these are often a good fit. Agents, brokers and relationship managers are the lifeblood of the financial services industry, and their work often determines the longevity and success of the organization they work for.

career_opportunities.title: Investment Banking
career_opportunities.description: Some of the most glamorous - and intense - financial careers are jobs in investment banking. Investment-banking jobs deal with facilitating the issuance of corporate securities and making these securities available for investors to purchase, all while trading securities and providing financial advice to both corporations and wealthy individual investors.

career_opportunities.title: Commercial Banking
career_opportunities.description: Commercial Banks from large entities to local institutions, offer a range of financial services, from checking and savings accounts to IRAs and loans. Career options available in this sector include bank tellers, loan officers, operations, and marketing and branch managers.

career_opportunities.title: Corporate Finance
career_opportunities.description: Corporate finance jobs involve working for a company in the capacity of finding and managing the capital necessary to run the enterprise. This is done while maximizing corporate value and reducing financial risk.

career_opportunities.title: Private Equity and Venture Capital
career_opportunities.description: Private-equity professionals help businesses find capital for both expansion and current operations. They also provide financing for a number of corporate business transactions, such as managed buyouts and restructurings. Venture-capital professionals (VCs) spend most of their time with startups or small, fast-growth companies. Venture-capital firms evaluate pitches by founders and small-company leaders to determine if the firm will make an investment.

career_opportunities.title: Investment Management
career_opportunities.description: The investment management area includes mutual funds, ETFs, hedge funds, and other private investment companies. As the name implies, investment management involves the soliciting of funds from investors with the objective of generating good returns for the investors. Jobs range from very sales oriented, to very quantitative, to very customer service focused.

career_opportunities.title: Retail Banking
career_opportunities.description: Retail bankers assist individuals with their personal financial needs, including auto and home loans, deposit and savings accounts, and insurance and investments (usually as a referral). A retail banker has extensive customer contact each day. Most of this customer contact would occur in their branch, either in person or on the phone.

work_description: Provide financial information and analyze change Monitor and interpret cash flows and predict future trends Formulate strategic and long-term business plans Analyze competitors and market trends Develop financial management mechanisms that minimize financial risks Conduct reviews and evaluations for cost-reduction opportunities Manage a company's financial accounting, monitoring and reporting systems Develop external relationships with appropriate contacts, e.g., auditors, solicitors, bankers and statutory organizations

career_opportunities.title: Brokerage Firms
career_opportunities.description: A certified stock broker can work with a brokerage firm such as Share khan or India bulls as their agent. The work involves contacting clients and managing their investments in stock market products. The benefit of working in a brokerage firm is that it provides more security and stableness than working individually.

career_opportunities.title: Independent Broker
career_opportunities.description: A certified stock broker can also work as an independent agent. He/she has to find new clients herself/himself and thus needs more interpersonal as well domain knowledge than what would typically be required of an agent working with a firm. The positive and the negative side is that an independent agent can determine his/her own commission and thus lose or win big if he manages to invest in a profitable stock.

career_opportunities.title: Equity Analyst
career_opportunities.description: An Equity analyst is one who studies organizations' metrics to determine risk and profitability of its stocks and other financial products. He/she can work independently, but most often are employed by large brokerage firms or even by business organizations.

career_opportunities.title: Bank Broker
career_opportunities.description: A Bank broker does the same work as other brokers do that is to sell and buy shares and other financial products for clients albeit in a bank. The major difference though is that the agent doesn't have to run around prospective customers rather bank provides a steady stream of customers who would themselves contact you.

work_description: Manage investments for individuals, companies or large organizations and review their investment portfolios Buy and sell stocks, shares and other financial products Carry out Research on the financial markets Keep clients informed about their investments and changes in the market by developing investment strategies Consult investment analysts Liaise with sales traders/clients on market movements Predict how markets will move and buy and sell accordingly Conduct exhaustive data analysis to analyze trends for decision making

Cons: Work pressure can be high Monotonous and low on creativity job Needs a person to be very alert and accurate

career_opportunities.title: Public/Private sector banks
career_opportunities.description: To work in a private or a public sector banks one should first clear Bank PO exams for the entry level jobs. For higher level jobs such as that of a manager usually requires a higher degree such as that of a Chartered Account. Banking jobs offer stable and fairly remunerative jobs to individuals with good mathematical and management skills.

career_opportunities.title: Investment Banking/Merchant Banking
career_opportunities.description: An Investment banker is someone who is a specialized professional trained in fund management. He/she is also trained in risk assessment of securities, bonds and other tradable products. A strong interest in numbers and reading patterns is a must to be successful as an investment banker. A qualified professional can either work individually or can work in an investment bank such as JP Morgan and others. It is one of the most remunerative career options in recent times.

career_opportunities.title: Credit Analyst
career_opportunities.description: A credit analyst is a trained professional who analyses, risk in various financial products such as securities, bonds, loans, etc. These professionals not only have the knowledge to predict markets but bigger national economies as well. A good trained individual can work with banks or brokerage firms. Usually a degree in finance and a higher degree in actuarial science is sufficient to enter the profession.

items.description: A career in Commerce & Accounts opens the pathway to multiple career options in the field of business management, accounting, banking & finance as well as marketing sales. One can pursue degree programs as well as certification programs or a combination of both at the graduate level. Many students are able to master both degree and certification programs with dedication and hard work. Bachelor in Commerce, Bachelor in Business Administration, Bachelor in Management Studies, Bachelor of Commerce in Banking & Insurance, Bachelor of Commerce in Financial Markets, Chartered Accountancy, Company Secretary, Cost Accountancy, Chartered Financial Analyst, Forensic Accounting, Economics, Actuarial Sciences are some of the most sought after programs in this domain. Chartered Accountancy is one of the most sought after and respected certification programs for aspirants. Over the last decade, a degree in commerce & accounts is further enriched by several specialized pathways in sectors like Finance, Banking and Insurance. Thus the career prospects in commerce and its interdisciplinary domains are extremely bright. Very good growth prospects, shorter learning and training time-span, high employment opportunities are some of the factors which have made a career in commerce and accounts quite popular amongst the youth. Employment opportunities are excellent with top MNC's across industries, Audit Firms and CA Firms who are always on the lookout for bright talent in this domain. Trending Fields: MBA, CFA, CA, BBA, BMS, Actuarial Sciences, Economics, Entrepreneurship

With growing economy worldwide, professionals with background in commerce are in great demand in colleges and universities, banks, rating agencies, securities firms etc. Some of them can pay managers, businessmen in 6 figures. They have a high ability to influence the standard of living of an average man on the street. career_opportunities.title: Chartered Acccountancy
career_opportunities.description: Chartered Accountancy is one of the most looked-after and respected career option in India, particularly in the commerce sector, with endless opportunities in the private as well as the public sector. A Chartered Accountant (CA) is concerned to ensure that the financial transactions of an organisation are maintained according to the law. They also keep track of the cost of management of the company and manage tax matters, and are involved in providing the professional opinions to a fiscal decision in a firm. The work-profile of a chartered accountant is enormous, varying from finance management, financial controlling, financial advisory or being a director. Cost accountancy is one of the most flourishing field in this discipline. A person can also explore the career in CFA (Chartered Finance Accounting) and look forward to becoming a Portfolio or a Risk Manager.

career_opportunities.title: Banking
career_opportunities.description: Banking, today, is a calling career for enthusiasts in the field of commerce and accounts. It is a crucial step towards understanding the global economy as well as discovering the challenges of the marketplace. This field has tremendous opportunities in local, national and foreign banks. Moreover, this field is concerned with accepting and safeguarding monetary funds in both private and public banks.

career_opportunities.title: Business Finance
career_opportunities.description: A career in business finance encompasses a concern related to the monetary information in terms of increasing profit and minimizing financial risks. Business finance covers a wide variety of opportunities such as global finance, budget analysis, property management and financial forecasting. Thus, this discipline revolves around the capital funds  and other valuable assets.

career_opportunities.title: Management
career_opportunities.description: Management as a career includes a wide variety of options which may stretch across any sector or industry involving planning, organizing, directing or monitoring an organization to achieve their goals. The roles of the management person involve decision making, interpersonal coordination or handling information.

career_opportunities.title: Auditing and tax
career_opportunities.description: This discipline is concerned with the review of financial records to determine the tax liability, revenue mobilisation as well as managing resources for National Budgets for effective functioning of the macroeconomic management. In addition, the individuals also aid interventions to support revenue mobilisation for growth and improvement of tax policies.

career_opportunities.title: Marketing and Advertising
career_opportunities.description: Marketing careers are a link between the organization and customers and the field is best for people who like to strategize and identify patterns and trends. Given India?-?s flourishing corporate growth, a career in marketing is lucrative. The various marketing job profiles include - project managers, marketing managers, market analysts, sales managers, etc., identifying the need and potential markets for products or services, developing products, formulating a pricing and sales strategies for business growth to increase profitability and maintaining public relations.

career_opportunities.title: Capital Markets
career_opportunities.description: The Capital Market is involved with the trading of the financial securities like bonds, stock, etc. The money is being channelled from savers and depository institutions to the borrowers and investees through various modes of securities like bonds, notes and shares.

Opportunity to work in diverse fields such as audit, taxation, advisory, corporate finance, and risk management. Can pursue independent practice or entrepreneurship after qualification. career_opportunities.title: Audit & Assurance
career_opportunities.description: Audit professionals examine financial records and internal controls to ensure that financial statements are accurate and comply with accounting standards and regulations. They help organizations improve transparency, manage risks, and build stakeholder confidence.

career_opportunities.title: Taxation
career_opportunities.description: Tax professionals advise individuals and businesses on tax planning, compliance, and regulatory requirements. They help optimize tax liabilities while ensuring adherence to applicable tax laws and regulations.

career_opportunities.title: Risk Advisory
career_opportunities.description: Risk advisory professionals identify, assess, and mitigate business, financial, operational, and regulatory risks. They help organizations strengthen internal controls, governance frameworks, and risk management practices.

career_opportunities.title: Management Consulting
career_opportunities.description: Management consultants help organizations improve business performance by analyzing operations, identifying inefficiencies, and recommending strategic, financial, and operational improvements. They often work on transformation, process improvement, and growth initiatives.

career_opportunities.title: Forensic Accounting
career_opportunities.description: Forensic accountants investigate financial fraud, embezzlement, money laundering, and other financial irregularities. Their findings are often used in legal proceedings, regulatory investigations, and dispute resolution.

career_opportunities.title: Internal Audit
career_opportunities.description: Internal auditors evaluate an organization's internal controls, risk management processes, and operational efficiency. They provide independent assurance and recommendations to improve governance and business performance.

career_opportunities.title: Compliance & Governance
career_opportunities.description: Compliance and governance professionals ensure that organizations adhere to laws, regulations, ethical standards, and corporate policies. They help establish governance frameworks that promote accountability, transparency, and regulatory compliance.

work_description: Examine financial statements and records to ensure accuracy and compliance with accounting standards, laws, and regulations. Prepare tax returns, provide tax planning advice, and ensure compliance with taxation requirements. Review accounting systems, internal controls, and financial processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness. Conduct internal audits, risk assessments, and compliance reviews to identify and mitigate business risks. Assess financial performance and advise management on cost optimization, revenue enhancement, budgeting, and business strategy. Support mergers, acquisitions, valuations, corporate restructuring, and other strategic financial transactions. Perform forensic accounting and financial investigations where required. Provide recommendations on financial management, governance, and regulatory compliance to support informed decision-making.

items.description: Actuaries are among the highest paid professionals today. Actuarial Sciences are often called financial astrologers applying statistical methods and mathematical skills to determine level of risk in finance, insurance and other professions. Endless opportunities, assurance of high salary and high job security are some of the reasons why actuarial sciences is emerging to be a sought after career option.  An actuary may specialize in health insurance, life insurance, property and casualty insurance or pension and retirement benefits. It is a field that requires intense numerical and statistical knowledge. An actuary has a fellowship of bodies like  Actuarial Society of India (ASI) Mumbai/ Institute of Actuaries London. Many universities also offer graduate degrees such as  B.Sc. in Insurance, or in Actuarial Science and post graduate degrees like M.B.A. in Actuarial Science, or Diploma Courses in Actuarial Science. Top recruiters in this sector include Insurance Companies, Banking Companies, Government Bodies & Consulting Companies. Trending Field: Health Insurance, Life Insurance

items.description: Economics is the study of deep insight in economical functions at macro and micro levels to handle the global market. It is the science of economic system and theories that manages production, distribution and consumption of goods and services. Economics favours quantitative skills and critical thinkers. Fields involved in economics are econometrics, international economics, economic policy making, public finance, development economics, monitory economics, etc. Economics as a career provides good opportunities to conquer an edge in today's globalizing world. The industrial sector has great demand for economist at both the national and international level. The fastest growth in demand for economics is being witnessed in the private sector, especially in the areas of consulting and economic research. Economists are equally important in the government sector, entry to which is on the basis of UPSC examination (Civil Services in IES). Candidates aspiring for career in Economics must have passed the 10+2 (HSC) examination from recognized Board/University with Economics as one of the recommended subjects. One can move on to pursue  Bachelor's degree  in Economics followed by a Master's Degree or Doctor of Philosophy degree for prospective economists to be competitive. However, job prospects are open after graduation itself. The top recruiters include Private and Public Banks, Private and Government Research Centres, Multi National Companies, Consulting Companies. Trending Field: Business Economics, Monetary economics, Financial economics

Pros: Economics is one of the most sought after career options. With growing economy worldwide, economists are in great demand in colleges and universities, banks, rating agencies, securities firms etc. Some of them can pay an economist in 6 figures. They have a high ability to influence the standard of living of an average man on the street. An experienced & knowledgeable Economist can talk his way out & gain respect from people from all walks of life. An economist is better informed of the complexities in the world.
Cons: A career in economics has a wide scope, however, it’s not everyone’s piece of pie. One has to be in the know-about of all economic events happening in the world, be consistent throughout the graduation and post-graduation period and even after his studies are completed.

career_opportunities.title: Government and advocacy jobs
career_opportunities.description: A wide range of government occupations, from urban planning to legislature to intelligence bodies, are available for those with a majors in political science. Many political scientists in Central, State and Local Government are engaged in research and evaluation of functions of the Government. Some are administrators and many others are engaged in policy analysis or problem solving for the intelligence agencies.

career_opportunities.title: Lobbyist Professions
career_opportunities.description: One can find jobs lobbying the government on behalf of interest groups and other non-government organizations. These individuals work closely with various stages of government, negotiating with elected officials and influencing policy to advance the goals of their employers or clients.

career_opportunities.title: Teaching Professions
career_opportunities.description: Employment opportunities for individuals with political science majors are available at the school level and at the college level.

career_opportunities.title: Media
career_opportunities.description: An individual with political science degree and an experience of 3-5 years in journalism can find jobs in the media as a Political Correspondent whose job is to prepare political reports, articles and interviews for print and online publications, as well as television and radio broadcasts.

career_opportunities.title: Research
career_opportunities.description: Public Opinion Research and analysis is of interest to those in politics, and communication. One might also be employed in a university, business organisation, non-profit organisation or an advocacy sector. One might also head one's own research and consulting firm.

career_opportunities.title: Business Organisations
career_opportunities.description: In industries, they are often employed as industrial political scientists. Their main duties are to evaluate the effects of laws and policies on business and forecast political, economic and social trends.

career_opportunities.title: Politicians
career_opportunities.description: Politicians represent the political, financial, administrative, economic, educational and other interests of their communities, and attempt to become elected to represent those interests on a legislative level. Politicians may perform their duties at a municipal, regional or national level.

career_opportunities.title: Law Careers
career_opportunities.description: There are several aspects of law that might appeal to students with an undergraduate political science degree. Such jobs incorporate the understanding and enforcement of government rules, the interpretation of political ideas and the use of analytical skills. In addition to private practice, lawyers can work at the corporate level or for public sector institutions. They might also work as consumer advocates, judges or district attorneys.

work_description: Publish research results through academic publications, written reports, or public presentations Develop and test theories, using information from interviews, newspapers, periodicals, case law, historical papers, polls, or statistical sources Collect, analyze, and interpret data such as election results and public opinion surveys, reporting on findings, recommendations, and conclusions Evaluate programmes and policies, and make related recommendations to institutions and organizations Write drafts of legislative proposals, and prepare speeches, correspondence, and policy papers for governmental use Forecast political, economic, and social trends Consult and advise government officials, civic bodies, research agencies, media, political parties, and others concerned with political issues Provide media commentary or criticism related to public policy and political issues and events

career_opportunities.title: Brain science and cognitive psychologists
career_opportunities.description: Cognitive Psychologists study how the human brain works- how we think, remember and learn. They apply psychological science to understand how we perceive events and make decisions. This work can range from exploring how we learn language to understanding the interplay between cognition and emotion.

career_opportunities.title: Clinical Psychologists
career_opportunities.description: These are psychologists who provide clinical or counseling services, to address a breadth of mental, emotional and behavioral disorders, integrating the science of psychology with the prevention, assessment, diagnosis and treatment of a wide variety of complicated human problems. They also promote change, resilience and help people discover their strengths.

career_opportunities.title: Counselling Psychologists
career_opportunities.description: Counselling psychologists help people recognize their strengths and cope with everyday problems. Counselling psychologists focus on interactions between people and their environment, and on educational and career development.

career_opportunities.title: Developmental Psychologists
career_opportunities.description: Developmental psychologists focus on understanding how humans learn, mature and adapt. Developmental psychologists study how people grow, develop and adapt at different life stages.

career_opportunities.title: Forensic and Public Service Psychologists
career_opportunities.description: Forensic and public service psychologists play important roles within the public safety and judicial systems. They conduct evaluations that inform and guide legal proceedings - from decisions regarding child custody to the competency of a defendant to stand trial.

career_opportunities.title: Industrial and organizational psychologists
career_opportunities.description: Industrial and Organizational psychology is the scientific study of human behavior in the workplace. It focuses on assessing individual, group and organizational dynamics and using that research to identify solutions to problems that improve the well-being and performance of an organization and its employees.

career_opportunities.title: Quantitative psychologists
career_opportunities.description: Psychologists use a number of research methods and comb through vast amounts of data to test hypotheses and study complex issues in the real world. Quantitative psychologists are expert in designing methodologies and studies that reveal answers to research questions on topics as diverse as human performance, child development, and memory and language retention.

career_opportunities.title: Rehabilitation Psychologists
career_opportunities.description: Rehabilitation psychologists study and work with individuals with disabilities and chronic health conditions to help them overcome challenges and improve their quality of life.

career_opportunities.title: Sport and Performance Psychology
career_opportunities.description: Sport and performance psychologists focus on identifying and applying psychological principles that facilitate peak sport performance, enhance people's participation in physical activities and help athletes achieve optimal human performance.

work_description: Design and implement behaviour modification programmes Identify psychological, emotional, or behavioural issues and diagnose disorders, using information obtained from interviews, tests, records, and reference materials Counsel individuals, groups, or families to help them understand problems, deal with crisis situations, define goals, and develop realistic action plans Develop therapeutic and treatment plans based on clients' interests, abilities, and needs Provide educational programmes on topics such as classroom management, teaching strategies, or parenting skills Conduct research studies of physical work environments, organizational structures, communication systems and group interactions to assess organizational functioning Formulate interview techniques, rating scales, and psychological tests used to assess skills, abilities, and interests

career_opportunities.title: Research arena
career_opportunities.description: Sociologists do research on the problems and development of societies and the ways that humans interact. The research topics may include class, gender, race, social movement or any other related topic.

career_opportunities.title: Social and community services
career_opportunities.description: Community agencies value employees with backgrounds in fields like sociology to address problems facing certain populations within society. Examples of jobs in this area might include: working in community development agencies, or environmental groups, and social service and nonprofit organizations benefiting juveniles, the elderly, and other special populations. Fund-raising or administration within these areas is also possible.

career_opportunities.title: Criminal Justice system
career_opportunities.description: Criminology is the field where criminal justice and sociology meet. A degree in sociology may open opportunities for a person to get employed as a corrections officer, criminal investigator, parole officer, or also as court paralegal.

career_opportunities.title: Education
career_opportunities.description: One with, a sociology degree may also choose to teach at the school level or at the college level after earning a PhD in sociology.

career_opportunities.title: Governance and Public Administration
career_opportunities.description: Generally, sociologists make good public administrators as they can easily relate to issues involving caste, gender, power, race, language, race, ethnicity, organizational power and identity.

career_opportunities.title: Media
career_opportunities.description: Sociologists, who have an expertise in understanding social relationships, social behavior and the society are in demand in this field because media reflects and influences the society and culture. One could work with advertising companies, publishing houses or as a public relations specialist. One can also consider becoming a journalist.

career_opportunities.title: Corporate sector
career_opportunities.description: In the Corporate Social Responsibility Sector (CSR), sociologists are in demand to encourage activities relating to the protection of environment, welfare of the consumers, employees, communities, and other stakeholders. Pursuing a career in human resource manager is also a viable option. One may also be interested to work with marketing research agencies.

work_description: Formulate publications and reports containing research findings Analyze and interpret data to understand human social behaviour Plan and conduct research to develop and test theories about societal issues Collect data on the attitudes, values, and behavior of people in groups, using observation, interviews, and review of documents Consult and advise individuals such as administrators, social workers, and legislators regarding social issues and policies Design approaches to the solution of groups' problems, based on research findings in sociology and related disciplines Observe group interactions and role affiliations to collect data, identify problems, evaluate progress, and determine the need for additional change Develop problem intervention procedures, using techniques such as interviews, consultations, role playing, and participant observation of group interactions

career_opportunities.title: Cartographer
career_opportunities.description: A cartographer is involved with the scientific, technological and artistic aspects of developing and producing maps. They present complex information as diagrams, charts and spreadsheets, as well as in the form of conventional maps. Geographical information systems (GIS) and digital-mapping techniques now dominate the role. They work within a variety of areas including publishing, the military, the government, surveying and conservation.

career_opportunities.title: Surveyor
career_opportunities.description: Surveyors measure and collect data on specific areas of land, including information about boundaries, buildings and features, both natural and man-made. They can join the Survey of India or State Survey Departments or Private organizations.

career_opportunities.title: Drafter
career_opportunities.description: Drafters work with surveyors, engineers and architects to develop maps used by construction companies, government planning entities or environmental organizations.

career_opportunities.title: Government Employee
career_opportunities.description: A few central government organizations that look for postgraduates in Geography are Oil & Natural Gas Corporation, National Council for Cement and Building Materials, Central Mine Planning & Design Institute Limited, Society of Integrated Coastal Management, etc. The post-graduate students in Geography can get placed in different departments under State Government through various exams organized by the Public Service Commission. One can also apply for the Probationary Officer post in various public-sector banks. For this, one needs to qualify the entrance test carried out by the banks. The Railway department also selects candidates to the various posts through the entrance test carried out by the Railway Recruitment Board or RRB. Postgraduates in geography can also apply for the posts in Indian Railway Traffic Service.

career_opportunities.title: Urban and Regional Planner
career_opportunities.description: Urban and Regional planners make long and short-term plans/goals about the use of land in cities or villages. They keep in mind the future needs of the city's population and recommend placement of various infrastructures such as schools or roads.

career_opportunities.title: GIS Specialist
career_opportunities.description: GIS technicians make maps and customized geographic information systems (GIS) applications and manipulate data to serve a variety of purposes. They read and interpret maps, manipulate and understand digital land data, and manage data entered into a GIS database. GIS technicians typically earn a Bachelor of Science degree in geography. A master's degree in geography can increase opportunities for career advancement and salary potential.

career_opportunities.title: Climatologist
career_opportunities.description: Climatologists are atmospheric scientists who study the Earth's climate. They collect and analyze data from sources such as ice cores, soil, water, air, and even plant life to find patterns in weather and learn how those patterns affect the Earth and its inhabitants

career_opportunities.title: Meteorologist
career_opportunities.description: Meteorologists study the relationships between atmospheric characteristics and the environment. They predict future weather conditions, study climate trends over time, track ozone levels, study rainfall and monitor global temperature. Meteorologists are needed in both urban and rural regions.

career_opportunities.title: Transportation manager
career_opportunities.description: A transportation manager ensures that shipments into or out of an organization are handled quickly, safely, and within budget constraints. This might include oversight of transportation equipment and personnel operated by an organization.

career_opportunities.title: Environmental Manager
career_opportunities.description: Environmental managers are responsible for making sure an organization is compliant with environmental regulations in areas such as air quality, waste, clean water, and pollution. Environmental managers play a scientific and administrative role in an organization.

career_opportunities.title: Researcher
career_opportunities.description: Many Government and non-government institutes along with research centres offer several career options for people holding geography degrees.

career_opportunities.title: Education
career_opportunities.description: One can also work in the educational sector as a teacher/ professor in the school level or the college level respectively.

career_opportunities.title: Demographer
career_opportunities.description: A demographer conducts statistical examinations of the composition, distribution and transition of the human population.

work_description: Gather geographic data through field observations, maps, photographs, satellite imagery, and census data Create and modify maps, graphs, diagrams, or other visual representations of geographic data Analyze geographic distributions of physical and cultural phenomena on local, regional, continental, or global scales Use geographic information system (GIS) technology to collect, analyze, and display data Combine geographic data with data on a particular specialty, such as economics, the environment, health, or politics Provide consulting services in fields such as resource development and management, business location and market area analysis, environmental hazards, regional cultural history, and urban social planning Study the economic, political, and cultural characteristics of a specific region population

career_opportunities.description: After earning an advanced degree in history, one might choose Research Historian as a career. Indian Council of Historian Research ( ICHR) is an autonomous organization that encourages historical research.

career_opportunities.title: Government Organizations
career_opportunities.description: A history degree is also useful in the civil services. One might conduct research to provide historical context for current policy issues or do some other related work. Intelligence Agencies also hire historians to write history of significant moments or events within the agency.

career_opportunities.title: Historical Associations
career_opportunities.description: Historians preserve artifacts and explain the historical significance of a wide variety of subjects, such as historic buildings, battlegrounds, religious groups etc.

career_opportunities.title: Education
career_opportunities.description: After earning a Ph.D degree in history one may become a professor in the college settings or also choose to become a high school teacher or a post-secondary teacher with a B.Ed. degree.

career_opportunities.title: Editing and Publishing
career_opportunities.description: Students of history may find employment in a wide variety of publishing areas, including university presses, textbook and trade houses, magazines and journals, professional associations, museums, and institutional publication offices.

career_opportunities.title: Consultants and Contractors
career_opportunities.description: A career in consulting is ideal for historians who are adventurous or prefer flexibility and a variety of projects. History consultants can perform jobs such as preparing surveying site's, processing an archival collection for a corporation, or researching an exhibit for a museum or court case. Contract historians on the other hand often work on projects in historic preservation, archaeology, architectural history, landscape architecture, and litigation.

work_description: Gather historical data from sources such as archives, court records, diaries, news files, and photographs Conduct historical research for the identification, conservation, and reconstruction of historic places and materials Research on and prepare manuscripts in support of public programming and the development of exhibits at historic sites, museums, libraries, and archives Recommend actions related to historical art, such as which items to add to a collection or which items to display in an exhibition Advise individuals and institutions regarding issues such as the historical authenticity of materials or the customs of a specific historical period Interview people to gather information about historical events and to record oral histories Impart and conduct research in colleges, universities, museums, and other research agencies and schools

career_opportunities.title: Numismatists
career_opportunities.description: Numismatics is the study of currency, i.e. coins, banknotes, or money as an exchange object in some other form like beads, tokens, and related objects. It also has numerous specialization like Exonumia (Study of Coin), Notaphily (Study of paper money) and Scripophily (study of stocks or bond).

career_opportunities.title: Epigraphists
career_opportunities.description: Epigraphy is the study of inscriptions or epigraphs as writing involving identifying graphemes, clarifying their meanings, classifying their uses according to dates and cultural contexts, and drawing conclusions about the writing and the writers. Thus, it has an artistic value of literary composition which aims to understand the purpose, style, political, religious and cultural traditions of the symbols of the inscriptions.

career_opportunities.title: Archivist
career_opportunities.description: Archivists acquire, manage and maintain documents and other materials that have historical importance for individuals, organizations and nations. They work with paper documents, photographs, maps, films, and computer record projects describing or preserving a body of records.

career_opportunities.title: Museologist
career_opportunities.description: Museology, or museum studies  the art of studying museums, museum curation, and how museums developed into their institutional role in education in the context of social and political forces. They are employed as dieticians in hospitals, schools and various other organizations.

career_opportunities.description: Health Centers can provide special advice for the dietary needs of people suffering from different diseases. Suitable therapeutic nutrition and physical education would enable the home science graduate to set up support centers for people with special dietary needs. Guidance could be given to the individuals for keeping fit through diet and exercise and management of obesity and related conditions.

career_opportunities.description: The role of the dietitian is pivotal for food analysis, food management and food therapy. Dieticians and nutritionists are concerned about the individual needs and prescribe diet as per human physiology, calorie intake, bearing in mind the pros and cons of various diseases.
