career_opportunities.description: One of the major careers available are as food scientists, research associates, teachers and professors. Candidates with a masters degree can opt for teaching positions or research positions.

career_opportunities.description: The Home Science Graduates/Post-graduates can set up confectionery, Ice-cream Parlors and Bakery. They can use innovation skill to evolve their own products, In making dresses, interior designing and may design their own place in a way that's unique and exciting to the customers.

career_opportunities.description: The textile industry is one of the most flourishing in India with increasing focus on fashion and textile. Thus the job of the home science individual is in fabric construction, dyeing, printing and evaluating, identifying and selecting fabrics/products from suppliers based on the suitability and testing for performance under various conditions. Major job profile of home science graduates in textile industry is as apparel and textile designers.

career_opportunities.description: Resource Management involves the study of managing by organizing the home economically and effectively. The home not only implies the basic facts about house hold but the housing designs, furnishing by effective use of the money and labor using a method of getting the maximum work done through the minimum resources.

items.description: Social workers work with populations of all ages and may serve various cultural groups.  Social workers provide a wide range of services at the national, state and domestic levels. Depending on their specialty, one may work in schools, government agencies, hospitals, mental health clinics, community centre and career centres. Social workers identify those who need help, assess their situations and develop plans to address their needs. People interested in social work should be empathetic and compassionate towards other people with an urge to alleviate their problems. Career as a social worker is at its prime with various organizations looking for trained professionals in this domain. Career opportunities exist in both government as well as private sector. One may work with National or International NGO's or Industrial or Corporate Sector. Bachelor or Master's degree in Social Work is recommended to practice social work. Graduates from any field may enroll for masters degree in social work but  psychology, sociology, economics, and political science are recommended. Many institutions also offer M.Phil. and PhD programmes in Social Work. The top recruiters include NGOs (National or International ) like Green Peace, Smile Foundation, Aashayein etc. Schools and hospitals (Apollo, Maxx, Fortis etc.) also generate employment in these fields. Trending Field: Child social workers, Family social workers, Substance abuse social workers, Medical and public health social workers.

items.description: A career in Education and training is considered a noble one in India as well as across the globe. Educators pass on accumulated knowledge to the new generation shaping the future of the country. Educators requires a perfect blend of essential attributes like  patience, confidence, liking for and an understanding of children/ students. Education & training is such a broad domain that different skills and type of trainings are required for different levels. Areas of specialization include teaching at nursery schools, middle schools, high schools, colleges, universities, institutes, special schools etc. The demand for qualified educators is on rise and this trend is not likely to change anytime in the near future. Whether you're interested in working as a professor or elementary school teacher, a special educator  instructor or corporate trainer you're sure to find a career in education extremely rewarding. For different levels, a different set of qualification is required ranging from nursery which requires a higher secondary degree (10+2 examination) along with B.Ed. to university level, where one requires  at least a masters degree with NET qualification certificate. For aspirants planning to enter the domain of training they need to gain relevant expertise and experience. All top Schools and Colleges both in the private and public sector are constantly on the lookout for good talent in the field of education & training and are thus amongst the top recruiters. Training organizations and corporates are also on constant lookout for qualified trainers and experts.

items.description: Political Science is the study of politics. It majorly deals with governance systems and their power, domestic and international affairs, political activities, laws, constitution, and much more. It also requires one to understand political ideologies, institutions, policies, processes, and behaviour. The three major subdisciplines of political science are comparative politics, international relations, and political theory. It is a social science that aims at understanding the role of governance systems in different governments along with international bodies. To pursue this career field, it is recommended that students take up Political Science in high school.  The students can enroll in any university for a degree in Political science, after class 12. Major areas of recruitment include civil services, law, intelligence, international bodies, and domestic government.

career_opportunities.description: Editorial food stylists take photographs of food for cookbooks, recipe books, newspapers, magazines, and other editorials. This comprises photography that demonstrates the recipe, raw ingredients, and other kitchen products.

career_opportunities.description: Marketing agencies and advertising agencies hire advertising food stylists. Clients provide them with briefs outlining their requirements. According to the storyboard, one must use the recommended colours, props, and visuals.

career_opportunities.description: Web food stylists style food items so they can be used on websites, blogs, and e-books. The majority of the time, they don't require a lot of props or lighting. Their preference is for natural light because of its simple setup.

work_description: For a food stylist to achieve their goal of making a specific food item look its best, they must understand how food preparation, photography, and videography work. Food stylists often collaborate with chefs, editors, assistants, and photographers. There are many cases in which a food stylist is needed, especially when food is photographed. A stylist styles images of food appearing in advertisements, magazines, cookbooks and menus. It is the duty of the food stylist to source silverware, plates, and fabrics before a shoot to ensure the shots will look good on camera.

Being a pastry chef demands a lot ofresearch and development, which can be rewarding and delicious.
People who are open to new things or enjoy experimenting with recipes can become a successful pastry chef.
Cons:
Pastry chefs are required to work for long hours standing in the kitchen and do repetitive tasks.
They need to start work early in the morning around 3 - 4 AM.
Sometimes day-to-day responsibilities can become overwhelming.

career_opportunities.description: Pastry chefs can work in high end hotels, restaurants, resorts, cruises. They can also work in bakery, patisserie and some cafes.
Pastry chef can open their own bakeries or dessert place where they can showcase their creative and artistic skills and gain experience. They can opt for their own baking or catering business.
Pastry Chefs can also work in academic institutes of Culinary Art to train other students with the skills.

work_description: Creating, testing and evaluating new pastry and dessert recipes.
Keeping a budget for the pastry kitchen.
Buying fresh fruits and odering supplies from various vendors.
Supervising chefs in training in the pastry kitchen.
Discuss menu planning with the other chefs in the restaurant.
Keeping the kitchen organized.

Liaise with suppliers and manage the budget of ingredients and equipment.
Ensure timely and highest quality service of the food.

items.description: Psychology is a lucrative field that seeks to understand the mind & behaviour. Students pursuing this career field are expected to study the mind in relation to various factors such as mental processes, brain functions, and behaviour. To get admissions in this field, students can apply to different colleges and universities after class 12. It is suggested to study Psychology at high school. Many universities accept admission either through a merit-based system or through a specific university-based entrance exam. Psychologists are often required in Hospitals, Schools, Private Organisations, NGOs, and more places where well-being and people skills are required. Trending fields: Clinical Psychology, Developmental Psychology, Behavioural Neuroscience,  Industrial Psychology, and Psychometry.

Pros:
A cognitive psychologist can help solve real-world problems.
Possibilities for self-employment through consulting.
Diverse career path opportunities.
Cons:
Teaching and research positions in cognitive psychology typically require a doctorate.
It can be exhausting and tedious to conduct research.

career_opportunities.title: Healthcare
career_opportunities.description: Mental health and healthcare settings are possible work settings for cognitive psychologists. Hospitals and mental health clinics may hire cognitive psychologists to help patients with cognitive difficulties. People with sensory or perception issues, conditions requiring cognitive therapy, etc., might be treated by them.

career_opportunities.title: Research
career_opportunities.description: A cognitive psychologist also conducts research to better understand mental processes. Many researchers also teach at universities. Studying and publishing their research in cognitive psychology allows us to gain a better understanding of a wide range of cognitive psychology subjects.

career_opportunities.title: Business
career_opportunities.description: Psychologists also work for businesses to conduct research, create products, and create marketing campaigns. A psychologist may either be employed directly by a company or provide consulting on a contract basis.

work_description: Cognitive research has numerous practical applications, such as increasing people's decision-making abilities and helping people cope with memory problems etc.
Cognitive psychologists provide valuable assistance to people who have suffered from problems with their mental processes.

Cognitive psychologists work in a variety of fields. They often conduct applied research or basic research concerning the human thought process. In addition to working at colleges and universities, cognitive psychologists are often employed by government agencies, companies, and in private consulting. Some cognitive psychologists may work in clinical areas.
A client and therapist can use cognitive behavior therapy or rational emotive behavior to focus on the underlying cognitive processes that contribute to psychological distress.

It is a specialised field which is high in demand.
It is among the highest paying professions.
The job is considered to be of repute and status.

career_opportunities.title: Clinics and hospitals
career_opportunities.description: The role is to diagnose, assess and treat mental, emotional and behavioural problems. They may choose to specialise in specific psychological disorders, such as anxiety, schizophrenia or depression

career_opportunities.title: Private practice
career_opportunities.description: They can open their own clinic and work independently.

career_opportunities.title: Schools and universities
career_opportunities.description: They work with school children who have learning disabilities or in college counseling centers to promote wellness and academic success.

career_opportunities.title: Community and mental health centers
career_opportunities.description: They work with special populations like children, the economically disadvantaged or seniors.

career_opportunities.title: Rehabilitation facilities
career_opportunities.description: They provide services with the goal of increasing function and quality of life for persons living with disability, activity limitations, and societal participation restrictions.

career_opportunities.title: Military
career_opportunities.description: Responsible for assessing, diagnosing, and treating military personnel with mental or emotional disorders. They offer therapeutic services, such as counseling, training and psychoeducational programs for military personnel, help cope with trauma and harsh working conditions.

career_opportunities.title: Teacher/Professor
career_opportunities.description: They can teach subjects like clinical psychology, abnormal psychology, psychopathology in universities, hospitals, work as a guest or visiting faculty.

career_opportunities.title: Prisons
career_opportunities.description: They provide treatment and psychological support to inmates both for existing mental disorders and to prevent them from committing any additional crimes. They have to testify as expert witnesses inside courtrooms. They facilitate therapy groups and manage their mental fitness.

work_description: They possess extensive knowledge of mental illness and how to diagnose and treat it
They perform research and collect data to enhance the understanding of clinical psychology
Identify and diagnose psychological, emotional or behavioral issues.
They help clients define goals and plan action to achieve personal, social, and educational development and adjustment.
A clinical psychologist conducts research and publishes research findings in industry journals.
They administer and interpret cognitive and personality tests
Monitor client progress through regular therapy sessions
Mental health issues across the lifespan based on a solid understanding of psychopathology.

Pros:
Developmental psychologists can make beneficial changes in people's lives, whether working in a research environment or in a therapeutic context.
They contribute to environmental Wellness 
Psychologists in the subject of developmental psychology can find jobs in a broad variety of environments, from schools and hospitals to government organisations. This facilitates obtaining jobs and also offers the opportunity to get experience in other areas.
The workplace and years of experience determines primarily the income, although there is surely possibility that will earn a decent salary.
Cons:
Psychologists may work highly demanding in all fields. Long hours and severe deadlines can generate a lot of stress for developmental psychologists working in scientific contexts. Those who work in clinical settings can be highly stressful in interacting with clients who have been subjected to incredibly tough life conditions.
As a result of dealing with clients in distress, all psychologists experience emotional exhaustion. Although many developmental psychologists don't interact with customers directly, those who do can hardly be protected against being emotionally drained from their profession.
The working time might be extensive and unpredictable especially for developmental psychologists working in clinical settings. Work tasks can often interrupt nights and weekends. Developmental psychologists often also work on vacation days.

career_opportunities.description: A developmental psychologist?s role is to study the growth and development of humans throughout their entire lifespan. Some developmental psychologists will focus on a specific type of patient, such as young children who are exhibiting developmental delays; while others will work with a particular age range of people, such as teenagers or adults.

an adolescent development specialist is a developmental psychologist that works exclusively with children in the adolescent stage, which is typically 13 to 19 years old. For example, you might use your understanding of the hormonal changes that occur during this part of the life stage to help kids understand how their body is changing and why, as well as to develop the skills needed to effectively deal with these changes on an emotional and behavioral level.

The purpose of behavioral therapy is to assist clients in identifying and overcoming problematic behaviors in their lives. To do so, one would utilize oner understanding of human development and how factors over the lifespan (i.e., family relationships, school pressures, work pressures, divorce, death) can heavily influence how a person behaves and interacts with others.

A school counselor provides a safe environment for children to turn to when they are feeling troubled. They are employed in schools and offer advice and guidance to children who seek their help. School counselors are employed to aid students in coping with the demands of school and personal issues, as well as offering them support to help them succeed academically.

A popular career for developmental psychologists is in research. In this capacity, you would seek to answer crucial questions about human development. For example, you might devise a research question that seeks to determine why ADHD develops in some populations of children and not in others.

As an education consultant, you would likely serve in an advisory role to assist teachers, school districts, and other stakeholders in developing developmentally-appropriate educational standards, learning targets, classroom policies and expectations, and so forth. For example, using developmental psychology principles, you might help a sixth-grade teacher develop unit-by-unit learning targets that challenge students of that age, but which aren?t too advanced or complicated, either.

With a background in developmental psychology, one can work as an early childhood education specialist. In this career, one work with children in preschool and elementary school to help them reach developmental milestones as appropriate for their age. For example, you might work directly with a four-year-old to help them develop the social skills required to share toys with other children.

work_description: Developmental psychologists operate in a number of environments, including universities, government organisations, health institutions and schools.

Those who work at universities and colleges tend mostly to focus on research or education. Other persons who operate in applied environments such as health centres or clinics help to evaluate, evaluate and treat people with developing impairments.
Developmental psychologists can also work in elderly, hospital, mental health clinics and homeless, supported living facilities.

career_opportunities.description: Forensic psychologist can work as counselors in a variety of settings like addiction treatment facilities, domestic violence shelters and also private practices. They can also work as counselors for inmates and ex-convicts. Providing treatment and necessary interventions for anyone related to legal and judicial system and even outside

They can also work directly with the victims or survivors of traumatic events by helping them in understanding the case, their rights, providing support during this process and attending the court hearing with them.

Forensic Psychologists can work as consultants with the aim of helping the client achieve the desired outcome in the case. They can aslo be consultants to police and law enforcement in criminal cases.

On behalf of the court, they may be required to do certain psychological evaluation so that legal decision can be made. These evaluations and assessments can be performed by forensic psychologists that work as clinicians.
They help the law enforcement agencies to detect criminals by collating data and providing statistical and strategic support.

Being a research, they focus on several aspects of criminology like criminal history, questioning suspects or victims related to the crime, etc. They also research about situations around a particular crime.
These professionals work to navigate the repercussions of a crime for all the parties that are involved and help the people who are directly affected by a criminal activity.

items.description: Geography is the science that studies Earth, its phenomenon, inhabitants, and the relationship between the different elements. It not only examines the natural properties of the environment but also how humans interact and get affected by it. Geography is not just limited to map making and understanding landforms. It forms an important part of many disciplines. This is one of the major reasons why it has been a crucial part of academic studies since the school level. Unlike other domains, geography has a very wide scope. From people, location, settlements, and politics to landforms, flora, and fauna, it covers it all.  Hence, it has been broadly divided into a few specialities that are physical geography, human geography, geographic techniques, and regional geography. Some of the trending fields in this domain are environmental consultant, cartographer, town planner, geographical information systems officer, conservation officer, and landscape architect.

work_description: In order to create maps, cartographers typically collect and verify data in the field. They also collect demographic information and population data.

A thematic map is prepared by analyzing and compiling data from satellite images, reports, surveys, and aerial photographs. In digital or graphic form, thematic maps are prepared for use in design, social, political, economic, and educational contexts.
Satellites, drones, and technologies like light-imaging detection and ranging (LIDAR) are all used by cartographers to obtain information.

They study aerial photographs and other sources of information using computers and large monitors, for which they spend most of their time in their offices. Some jobs, however, require extensive fieldwork to gather data and verify results. They collect & verify data through fieldwork which is used in the creation of maps.

items.description: International Relations is the study of strategic interaction between nations, international bodies, and non-governmental organizations with respect to politics, security, and trade. International organizations, foundations, and industries may also hire them in their Public Relations departments, acting as liaisons between company operations and the legal entities that regulate those activities.
International Relations professionals are interested in areas such as globalization, ecology, sustainable development, terrorism, and human rights.

For individuals to succeed as international consultants, they must not only understand different cultures but also be sensitive to cultural differences. It is imperative to adapt every aspect of one's business strategy to the area where one is doing business, whether that be management style, negotiation tactic, presentation approach, style of dress, etc.

items.description: The filmmaking industry is one of those domains that attracts students because of all the glamour and limelight involved in it. However, this domain is not all about actors, it?s much more than that. It includes both direct and indirect careers. Direct careers are those where the professionals are directly involved in the filmmaking process whereas indirect careers include distributors, critics, etc. Not all the careers in this domain require you to face the camera. There?s a lot that happens behind the camera, which has major demand for new talents. If you are someone who is creative, has attention to detail, the ability to innovate, and loves entertainment, this could be the domain for you. Major profiles here are director, producer, cinematographer, actor, screenplay writer, editor, etc.

work_description: Meet with the directors and read the script to understand their vision of the film.
Assemble all the raw footage, code and store the footage in the computer.
Ensure the story sequence and continuity while editing the film.
Collaborate with the VFX team to ensure the quality and progress?of editing the film.
Prepare a logical storyboard by a combination of the most effective scenes.
Decide and select important scenes, sounds and special effects and digitally cut the shots to put together the sequence of the film.
Prepare a ?rough cut? of the film or video and review the edited footage to identify and review recommend any changes.
Experiment with different film editing styles and skills and learn to use new and sophisticated technology.
Give suggestions for the settings, backdrop and scene, and the positioning of cameras etc.

career_opportunities.title: Camera Production Assistant
career_opportunities.description: Camera Production Assistants are trainees who assist the cinematographer with the film unit while learning the craft.

career_opportunities.title: Motion Control Operator
career_opportunities.description: Motion control operators are those who are tasked with operating the motion control equipment, which essentially produces 'camera robots' for special effects uses that systematically reproduce camera movements. A motion control rig is typically rented with an operator who is knowledgeable about the equipment.

career_opportunities.title: Camera Operator
career_opportunities.description: A Camera Operator is one who operates the camera as per the direction of the Cinematographer. On occasion, the cinematographers take on this task themselves if there isn't enough staff.

career_opportunities.title: First Camera Assistant
career_opportunities.description: The First Camera Assistant, or 1AC, keeps the camera in focus on the subject. Additionally, they put together the camera equipment and dismantle it once the job is done.

career_opportunities.title: Second Camera Assistant
career_opportunities.description: It is the Second Camera Assistant's responsibility to load the clapper board and load the film stock on the camera at the beginning of each take. Supervisors oversee the transport of equipment as well as the equipment itself.

work_description: Artistic perspective and a distinctive vision are important characteristics of a cinematographers work.
They also have an in-depth understanding of cameras, composition, and lighting, which allows them to achieve their vision.

A Cinematographer oversees the camera and lighting crews on a film or video production. Typically, they are involved at every stage of the production, from storyboarding to post-production. Together with the director, they create the images you see on screen.

career_opportunities.title: Film Editor
career_opportunities.description: They conceptualize, shoot and edit a variety of stories, educational scripts, that drive the organization’s objectives, under deadlines, in an ever-changing production landscape, coordinating pre-production work.

career_opportunities.title: Film Critic
career_opportunities.description: Film critics  review a movie's content and plot in depth, analyze the theme and evaluate how engaging the viewing experience was. They interview actors involved in making/ producing a film. They are sometimes required to research a subject or the technical details of a film.

career_opportunities.title: Tape Editor
career_opportunities.description: The tape editors execute the live webcast, on-screen graphics overlay, audio mixing, digital encoding for live and archival streams. They edit video footage to desired length and format, create motion graphics, and complete color corrections.

career_opportunities.title: Cinematographer
career_opportunities.description: A cinematographer, is the head of camera and light crews working on a movie, entertainment television production, news, or sports. They take the artistic and technical decisions related to the image.

career_opportunities.title: Screenwriter
career_opportunities.description: A screenwriter writes screenplays for television, film, and comics. Screenwriters are good at writing, storytelling, and use their imagination.

They supervise the work of the camera, lighting and sound crews
Film directors work in the editing process, cutting the film and integrating the pieces into the final product.?
Directors help actors better understand the characters they are playing by explaining the motivation behind a particular scene
They are involved during every stage of filmmaking and film production

items.description: AI involves developing algorithms and computer programs that can learn from data and perform tasks typically requiring human intelligence, such as speech recognition, image classification, and decision-making. On the other hand, data science involves using mathematical and statistical techniques to extract insights and knowledge from data. A career in AI and Data Science can be both exciting and challenging. These fields require a strong foundation in mathematics, statistics, and programming, as well as the ability to think critically and creatively. Some standard job titles in these fields include data scientist, machine learning engineer, AI researcher, and data analyst.

career_opportunities.title: Big Data Engineer
career_opportunities.description: Big Data Engineer creates an ecosystem for the business systems to interact efficiently. Their primary task is to build and effectively manage voluminous data of an organization. They also have to carry out the function of obtaining outcomes from business data in a robust manner. Programming languages like Python, R and Java are essential in building career in AI as a Big Data Engineer.

career_opportunities.title: Business Intelligence Developer
career_opportunities.description: Business Intelligence Developer has the primary responsibility of analyzing business data along with AI algorithms and models. They recognize different business trends by assessing complicated data sets. They help in swelling the profits of a company by preparing, analyzing and interpreting business intelligence solutions.

career_opportunities.title: Data Scientist
career_opportunities.description: Data scientist assisst in gathering relevant data from multiple sources for the pupose of assesing it to gain constructive inferences. The inferences gained are influential in tackling various issues concerned with the busines. Depending upon different data patterns, past and present information, data scientists make various predictions.

career_opportunities.title: Machine Learning Engineers
career_opportunities.description: Machine learning engineers are involved in building and maintaining automated solutions that facilitates machine learning initiatives. They work with huge chunks of data and possess extraordinary data management traits.

career_opportunities.title: Research Scientist
career_opportunities.description: Research scientists undertake efforts in performing extensive research dealing with aplications of machine learning and artificial intelligence. A research scientist is one who gained expertise in the field of applied mathematics, statistics, deep learning, and machine learning.

career_opportunities.title: AI Data Analyst
career_opportunities.description: AI data analyst performs data mining, data cleaning, and data interpretation. By cleaning data, requisite data is made suitable for data interpretation. Any sort of redundant data is discarded by them so that it does not hamper the data interpretation process.

career_opportunities.title: Product Manager
career_opportunities.description: In the field of AI, the duty of a product manager is to resolve challenging problems by strategically evaluating data. He must possess the skill of identifying relevant problems that obstructs the business proceedings. The next step is to get hold of related data sets to facilitate data interpretation. After data interpretation,the product manager is required to estimate business impacts from the outcomes of data interpretation.

career_opportunities.title: AI Engineer
career_opportunities.description: Artificial intelligence engineers are individuals who use AI and machine learning techniques to develop applications and systems that can help organizations increase efficiency, cut costs, increase profits, and make better business decisions. AI engineers are problem solvers who develop, test and apply different models of Artificial Intelligence. They effectively handle AI infrastructure. They make use of machine learning algorithms and understanding of neural networks to develop useful AI models.

career_opportunities.title: Robotics Scientist
career_opportunities.description: Roboticists are generally involved in the design, programmimg, construction, and testing of robots (automated software). They can work on any stage of development, from creating software to building hardware and troubleshooting the finished product.

work_description: The mission of an artificial intelligence engineer is to develop intelligent algorithms capable of learning, analysing and predicting future events. AI engineer also plays a role of a researcher. He or she analyses the functioning of the human brain in order to build computer programs with the same cognitive abilities as humans. An AI engineer develops algorithms that receive input data on the history of purchases, sales and products in order to predict future customer behaviour. Conduct statistical analysis and interpret the results so that they can guide the organization's decision-making process. Develop infrastructure for data transformation and ingestion. Study and transform data science prototypes. Design machine learning systems. Run machine learning tests and experiments. Perform statistical analysis and fine-tuning using test results. Train and retrain systems when necessary. Extend existing ML libraries and frameworks. Keep abreast of developments in the field.
